Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Team, after ALL the terrible lies George Santos has spread before and after his election, we can’t believe he’s STILL a sitting member of Congress!

Now, GOP legislators are finally calling for his expulsion.

**But unless we show MASSIVE grassroots support for this move, the plan will be abandoned and Santos will get off SCOT-FREE!**

[**We can’t let this opportunity pass us by: Please, join 4,999 top Democrats in signing our urgent petition DEMANDING George Santos be removed from Congress »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/signup/expel-santos/?source=VPP_20231016_EMPET_E4_T0_AC&t=8&akid=11248%2E878179%2EtmYULG)

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, OCTOBER 17
GREATER GEORGIA LAUNCHES GOTV CAMPAIGN FOR LOCAL ELECTIONS
ATLANTA - Today, Greater Georgia launched a get-out-the-vote campaign to mobilize conservatives ahead of Georgia's 2023 municipal elections. The text message campaign will target conservatives in cities with competitive local elections - and encourage them to vote early over the next three weeks.
Early voting for Georgia's municipal elections is ongoing and runs through November 3. Election Day is November 7. Voters can find their early voting location, as well as their sample ballot, by visiting [mvp.sos.ga.gov](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018w_Ppqz9qMAd0fGnA7Q7tIGIe9u9QQvDnxQLDs0IP5F4aGCrJscXk7MEieOsDgNGxMojYDdbebGwAIQbkeH2OsP2PFnlXzLbHnXKBU0AB4YY7OyKjCh6hipMkVFRW-rKFGhtoUDshYKFoaWfSCG1Fg==&c=jLyka069tCBye10g1GXEQl44cntN3Dgbj1RSdXTuFgU8_NvvYN6fhA==&ch=3i-IKbA3ohQ48xjAwB8jayINcS9SLIGUaRMLRoGPW5_BPLlDFxsqhA==).
"It's not a presidential election year, but Georgia voters still have important decisions to make at the ballot box," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "Our mayors, city council, and school board members impact quality of life for all - from families and small businesses to our safety and freedoms. It's why we're investing in a statewide awareness campaign to urge conservatives to vote early for strong local leadership."
---

The group works year-round to educate and register voters, engage with diverse and underrepresented communities, and protect election integrity. ###

name: Anthony D'Esposito
subject: Hate against Israel depends on forgetting
body:
Peter, This is why we must remember history, both current and decades ago. Our communities must be living reminders that are never silent. Brutal ongoing attacks by Hamas are based on beliefs that the world's Jewish homeland...
[](https://despositoforcongress.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xlkzul-dytjdljkkt-r/) Peter, Hate against Israel depends on forgetting. This is why we must remember history, both current and decades ago. **Our communities must be living reminders that are never silent.** Brutal ongoing attacks by Hamas are based on beliefs that the world's Jewish homeland shouldn't exist and that the Arab world should never normalize relations with Israel - both absurd propositions. **Israel is a necessary country. The horrors of the Holocaust were built on millennia of anti-Semitism and hatred towards Jews.** A Jewish homeland, vigorously defended, must be a worldwide commitment. Hamas denies history and depends on violence to stay relevant in global affairs. Twenty-three years ago they had the opportunity to build a lasting peace but shot it down - literally - because they are nothing without violence.More recently, Arab nations started normalizing relations with Israel. Their recognition of the necessity and vibrancy of the Jewish state was slowly but surely marginalizing Hamas. The deadly terrorist attacks on Israel is their response - shutting down diplomacy and forcing the world to take sides in a battle between peace and evil.New York's 4th Congressional District comprises diverse and caring Nassau County neighborhoods, including vibrant Jewish communities.**I know I speak for all of us in pledging America's unwavering support for Israel and sharing our prayers for our neighbors impacted by the attacks.** I'm sending this brief history lesson because criticism directed towards Israel, as she defends herself and responds to attacks, depends on forgetting. Forgetting that Hamas intentionally ruined earlier opportunities for peace and launched their deadly attacks to stop others from changing the world for the better.**We must always speak out against hate. I pledge to always do so.** Warmly,
Congressman Anthony D'Esposito | | [Unsubscribe](https://despositoforcongress.cmail20.com/t/y-u-xlkzul-dytjdljkkt-j/)

## Rep. **Jordan Gaining in Speaker Race**
Rep. Jim Jordan gained ground in his quest to become House Speaker, [winning support from several key GOP members](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsUD2zpCAQ_DWYYcGgjAYEl5jtpRdaHAzubLFiIbfW_ftXvvglnXRXf_15rA_Pmfftt3-Ta6msPjT-0KqV1CjBrEMXXSICMh05bWccBxwAu6cLs40TTnr-662J6AlnhXq2EwSrYhg6dqDAaKVRzeOoda9TMpg8meQxjNaIQVHkVmr_Kry3J6X8v3yo9qG8u-yerR2nML8ELAKW67r6o2RuHMotELBk_pD8d0Tf6BSw3GkCFq1usAKWUPat0nlzr1Kj3-XmeT9lqLeLz7LVe27ZpVIaNI5TV108Ls6ZT4tiUNvbc_6u035-5ysAAP__5-lkfw) who had previously opposed him. He still faces a difficult climb, but momentum shifted in his favor Monday. Among his new GOP supporters are Reps. Mike Rogers and Ann Wagner, who had both publicly vowed not to back him. Also openly on his side now are Rep. Vern Buchanan and Rep. Ken Calvert. Faced with this shift, Democrats launched an effort to defeat Jordan, [targeting 11 GOP incumbents](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAURL8Gd1jcC4a3BcVr3G3alBYyF5sNNhawtvL3kVOnmWZGmqPz-ZyeLqa4Lx9uI9tCntzc4kkTCA6Go5xU520gQpIdWdAPMyij0HSrlQaQhFCAWuswCwWeBgdgBPwjOUAXLQqUIMCIxzAA9BCCNMGRDM7Mg5ZMCfKx5dK_ctzbSiF955NKP-etS3Zt7ahM_mc4Mhyv6-qPnGKLc74HDMcUT-Lvw7tGleF4vzEcQdyhGY5z3pdC9e6WHPeFu9Co8Fcu3u18zcnnd6u8HuS-qHBPW-VLPrgQgGC06Yr1xxVTilUbpsSyuZh-4drfrn4CAAD___nLaPY) from swing states with a robocall campaign. The vote is scheduled for today at noon ET.

## FDA OK's New Cancer-Fighting Tech
The Food and Drug Administration approved a new technology that uses ultrasound waves [to blast apart tumors](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9uhSAUgPGnwQ3DP-U6MHRxu107mhM4KA16iHA19-2bdu78DV_y-3ouT0g5Hesn7OhapAV8SxcuUnBpudKL6YKLiAp1h06Okx2MNcp2m4tSjl7gAA_AadJawgMfMSgI2oxGyy45JZSWQloxDYOUvYxR2wioI1g_jJoZgSE1OvtvSkfbMOY3XXj2nvYuu621Upn-YGpmar7vuy9Uqk-_mam5od8OyrS-mZq3VBtVOpKvvL12Onml1xH4DRfyGIBDKSddkJmau9OFcqecUx0tM2LdIeW_Z_uf4CcAAP__DWpfPg) in the liver. The technique, known as histotripsy, requires no needles, knives, drugs, or radiation. A series of trials showed that the procedure effectively destroys liver tumors without harming patients. For patients, histotripsy could mean liver cancer treatments without radiation or chemotherapy, allowing far shorter recovery time and less treatment discomfort.

() Want to comment on a story? Head over to our . Enjoying The Flyover? Take a moment to check out today's sponsor, \- the future of proactive care. | Rep. Jordan Gaining in Speaker Race Rep. Jim Jordan gained ground in his quest to become House Speaker, who had previously opposed him. He still faces a difficult climb, but momentum shifted in his favor Monday. Among his new GOP supporters are Reps. Mike Rogers and Ann Wagner, who had both publicly vowed not to back him. Also openly on his side now are Rep. Vern Buchanan and Rep. Ken Calvert. Faced with this shift, Democrats launched an effort to defeat Jordan, from swing states with a robocall campaign. The vote is scheduled for today at noon ET. DeSantis Rescues Floridians Out of Israel Gov. Ron DeSantis announced that nearly 300 American evacuees trapped in Israel arrived safely in Tampa Sunday () after he issued an executive order authorizing the rescue of Floridians. DeSantis directed the Florida Division of Emergency Management to and partnered with nonprofit rescue agency Project Dynamo to coordinate the effort. The governor has criticized the federal government for moving too slowly to evacuate Americans. DeSantis said he estimated 20,000 citizens, including up to 1,000 Floridians, remained in Israel. FDA OK's New Cancer-Fighting Tech The Food and Drug Administration approved a new technology that uses ultrasound waves in the liver. The technique, known as histotripsy, requires no needles, knives, drugs, or radiation. A series of trials showed that the procedure effectively destroys liver tumors without harming patients. The FDA approval means the delivery platform, called Edison, for use with patients. For patients, histotripsy could mean liver cancer treatments without radiation or chemotherapy, allowing far shorter recovery time and less treatment discomfort. () | Flying together with: The Concierge Health Program Anyone Over 40 Needs to Live Better, Longer Are you healthy, really? You may be exercising and eating all the right things, yet still feeling just "average" -- unknowingly headed toward pre-diabetes, cognitive decline, or osteoporosis. October 17, 2023 Mark Hauck and his battle with the U.S. Dept. of Justice is a man of the hour, and his experience is a prime illustration that in many aspects of life, the law is applied unevenly to ordinary Americans. Last Friday night I attended the Family Institute of Connecticut's (FIC) annual banquet and fundraiser in Stamford. Peter Wolfgang, the Family Institute's executive director, hosts this soulful event every fall. It's a great gathering of those in CT who wage the fight for traditional values in what has become an ever-increasing legislative onslaught against us. In Peter's words, "at a time when laws should be passed to strengthen the family structure, measures are being implemented in Connecticut and nationally that are further undermining the family." As Peter reviews each year's actions, FIC's perennial theme is 'Standing in the Gap' - for that is exactly what they do as they galvanize opposition to some of the most odious bills proposed by 'progressive' committee hives in CT's legislature. For the 10th year in a row FIC led the effort to defeat the 'Assisted Suicide' bill in committee. FIC also pushed back efforts to advance a Bill incrementally normalizing the euphemistic 'Minor Attracted Persons' (MAPs), also known as pedophiles. Much of the past year's efforts were consumed with defeating an entire raft of equally corrosive proposed legislation. As William F. Buckley often said, "a conservative is someone who stands athwart history" - and in recognition of FIC's efforts, it was awarded the 'Defensive Player of the Year' award by the national organization, Family Policy Alliance. Back to Mark Hauck - he was Friday night's FIC keynote speaker. Mr. Hauck, a Kintnersville, PA man made international news a year ago when he was swatted by about 20 federal agents at 6:30am at his home, with his wife and seven children looking on. They were dressed in full riot gear, with guns drawn to create maximum intimidation of both his family, and anyone else sharing their traditional views and values. Hauck was a regular, praying outside a Philadelphia abortion clinic. A year prior, after persistent verbal intimidation of his young son by a clinic worker, Hauck pushed the man back, and he fell and required medical attention. The case was handled by local authorities. The Feds decided NOT to intervene in the case in Oct.'21, but in a 180-degree reversal, decided to indeed swat him at his home in Sept.'22. What changed? The Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade three months earlier - that's what! In its indignation for the Court's returning power back to the states and the people, Merrick Garland's DOJ decided to flaunt its true colors, and rain some maximum intimidation upon the head of a man who regularly stood in defiance and prayed. The DOJ's action was selective prosecution, and pursued with the intent that every Conservative in the land take note. It is lawfare, and its weapon of choice was the federal FACE Act (freedom to access clinic entrances). Laws such as the FACE act are written by progressives to virtue-signal their donors and special-interest groups. They are directed and targeted straight at conservatives and people of all stripes on the right side of the political spectrum. The FACE Act is loaded up with a penalty of 11 years in prison, which hung over Mr. Hauck's head... while incidentally, the maximum for involuntary manslaughter in PA is 10 years! With these laws there is no pretense of balance. This literally amounts to persecution of political enemies by those in control of the legislative and judicial apparatus - a clear illustration of two-tiered justice! Rather than accept a plea deal offered by DOJ, Mr. Hauck went to trial, facing 11 years. [He was acquitted by a jury.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001y2voreDW4f-txipccK8hXRu--5tqjUKiHeJzPPb7Gre0mvnRSsbuZJI0NsNMs6Ctu021KxdzhhoP_PofUy8N4Vlcs4CewdUO4h43PJeMfAUB2Ez0IC---WEB_ItAC0lHSXVGZSYjPqpSmpAJBKMw9n3Hg98yqNa18RuwznZjSuhvJYMV9ImFQEb2MhZaznqsSCPDJE4VmxYHoplHH9HoBzNP44QR0DsobxOa_d7avI9uMTd9dnnMe-B4ZdWECnvN&c=6WwEDQmjrO4cOzOXXJ6xxQal890HCuFidMcuuw-lIyLhe9ImvYrtTg==&ch=7EaExBNPYhoXNphmD-sU32ZyYUKlyZFogvnH9PrPOy-YmzDtB2ez7w==) Following the verdict, the judge lodged a formal notice with the DOJ stating the FACE Act was demonstrably bad law - so there's still hope. There are thousands across the country who have been caught in the crosshairs of a malignly repurposed justice system, whose stories have not made national news. Mark Hauck is just one of the many notables. And he came to Connecticut to bear witness to the fact that things have gone radically awry in our Federal government. Such virtue-signaling laws should be removed from the books, and power should be devolved back to the states and the people where it rightly, and constitutionally belongs. Jim Himes has never seen a Federal law he didn't like. He gladly supports laws targeting his political opponents, such as the FACE Act. And of course, he's done nothing in his 15-year reign to return any usurped Federal power back to its rightful place in the states.
The 2024 election will be a referendum on this man's failed 15-year rule. Jim Himes is NO Moderate

name: David Horowitz
subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpodqbnc7u8elsm9aqh6cukle1lgc1rl00o591ko_rp22sh2s8i66p77clim6or2cjh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zihlplmjtu535f71hmf0s59sbn225a3hgmnrgcag_rp22sh2s8i66p77clim6or2cjh2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
David Horowitz
---

But the clock is ticking and our country is hanging by a thread. **[Please make a generous donation of $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and as a thank you, I’ll rush a complimentary copy of my book The Enemy Within to you.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z33tanjoe382qobqgroegs58j0nc4dkifkf6i78g_rp22sh2s8i66p77clim6or2cjh2bs)**

My friend, the year is 1983. I was just 17 years old. President Reagan was in the White House, Scarface hit theaters, and Billboard’s year-end top song was "Every Breath You Take" by The Police. **But guess who else was there in '83? Marcy Kaptur, and she's still in Congress**** _40 years later._********She isn’t just a part of the swamp—Marcy is the swamp.** Ready for this? The picture on the left is of me around my high school graduation. The right? That’s Marcy, around the same year, being sworn into Congress...
---
[](http://links.craigriedelforcongress.com/u/click?_t=063960b10bde474cb034b193fc03c584&_m=6600d60c343c4744a7c8c275d22f89f9&_e=YjSuHBZ-WksbkgiCB1LwOj-pQ4n5NfztGfBfNCM51FJ_TZr3BNVmZj01FTnJlEgdu6z70EnV0CMcvIk2ERUefnzuNSRH7d6XAJphgyOqad257X2QTr_D2MOXTn1Tx44nGc3aGII5WoBQleQ2SnaR-cuGgbC8cPg2X2HFfJsi4wJdYFsSy-dQ3nU9QSGva4ucQ4Dg6k_CemumwgwzxFSY00Ms5DlbGeATLU8tYE9Avy5HOxXDxsWcucAkAeRys0icHOMFAkRJCtied8IKtf97NtBz2fzv6Fq9nSTSPC-UuEqvGH3dWEsGkr9Tmssp7e6UIoCsOuVnDurkdpWmdGeFcOHaM9r2ZJPXF6PHGgWAFpM%3D)
---
I love the '80s, but there's a limit to nostalgia. Marcy's been there since the year Return of the Jedi hit theaters—we've had a few more (some unwanted) Star Wars trilogies since then. **My friend, while many have tried and failed, our campaign is different. We are determined to end her 40-year reign, bring fresh ideas to Congress, and be a new voice for Ohio’s 9th Congressional District. ** **[Help us retire Marcy with your generous support:](http://links.craigriedelforcongress.com/u/click?_t=063960b10bde474cb034b193fc03c584&_m=6600d60c343c4744a7c8c275d22f89f9&_e=YjSuHBZ-WksbkgiCB1LwOj-pQ4n5NfztGfBfNCM51FJ_TZr3BNVmZj01FTnJlEgdu6z70EnV0CMcvIk2ERUefnzuNSRH7d6XAJphgyOqad257X2QTr_D2MOXTn1Tx44nGc3aGII5WoBQleQ2SnaR-cuGgbC8cPg2X2HFfJsi4wJdYFsSy-dQ3nU9QSGva4ucQ4Dg6k_CemumwgwzxFSY0xNK5hs655hTHiNwRYPU7U0ilwJcv2xsyNBPFCtMpUrnmd9uTGarJwjlZmpif1pGHNnvVMrsWMLI4Rf9O6cledY17lgZlpoWp1ZPtlhnN4-L6K2q309YKDyPhFeMY_YLircIO6DLDKYw0A_0cEM844E%3D)**

Sign up here!

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=aad3148d5a7e8716a502cf04f2e8abbad4e40beef5b5d5ecbc68d3ef7705b1383ed871804010a5f4aa71a8735fee0012f2fbd04896b775d9a584e5ce93bd5e50

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=aad3148d5a7e8716a502cf04f2e8abbad4e40beef5b5d5ecbc68d3ef7705b1383ed871804010a5f4aa71a8735fee0012f2fbd04896b775d9a584e5ce93bd5e50

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

Upcoming Roundtable: Truth in Taxation - Senators Jacobson, Linehan, and Briese discuss Nebraska tax reform | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ne.gop/n41kepo7ku-12656924?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=c859f3f85b&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

A lot can happen in a week.

In seven days atrocities of war can overwhelm our senses, the beginnings of which we are just getting a perception of. Social media and instant news makes us even more consumers of content as we want to believe it "can't be happening". We want to look away, but graphic images from Israel and continued destructive reports from Ukraine will more than likely join news from other countries in the Middle East or perhaps a third part of the globe in Taiwan. Then we see America. We see what is supposed to be a "United" States. I think many Americans genuinely struggle believing that any person of influence or leader in elected office has a proactive answer to what is going on. Secondly, Americans are then EXTREMELY concerned that if no leader is being proactive, if no one could SEE any and all of this coming, then how competent are the leaders in REACTING to the increasing chaos.

Worse, if they are a Republican elected official and they **use** the words of the "Values of the Party" to get ELECTED, if it says those values on the palm cards and they say them in their speeches to get ELECTED, why is compromise laced in the "solutions" when they GOVERN? Why is the compromise of values praised as politically strategic, when standing steadfast on integrity and character deemed radical or aggressive? Why is compromise to moderation always felt by the constituents, but never held accountable TO the policy maker?

Republicans of Nebraska...you are on the leading edge of change within this country. Change within the Republican party. **You have to persist.** You have to know that this is YOUR party again. Patriots from other states are watching Nebraska to see the "how and what" truly brings about change within a party. As Chairman of the NEGOP, I have had the privilege of witnessing the resurgence of our party at the local level. More county parties have become active in the last year than in the _previous decade_. At the local level we see a new dedication and commitment from individuals like you, from grassroots leaders and new members, who share the vision of a party that believes in the people of the party. Your continued support is crucial to building up the county party infrastructure so we can elect **Constitutional and Platform Republicans** at the local level.

The objective of the party is to maintain the government of, by, and for the people and to further the principles within the community. The state party must build the apparatus of resources and information for Republican candidates to win. My job as Chairman is to facilitate the relationships and the connection that builds communication of values and support among all Republicans. _**The voters of Nebraska must choose the winners**_.

A lot of progress can happen in a week.

In seven days, a leader like YOU can become equipped to make a difference in their community. Your county needs candidates. Mama bears and coaches and church leaders and grandparents and young Republicans to rise for 2024. _Yes, that means YOU_. We need our Board of Education and UNL Regents and Community College Boards to have value based and solution driven leaders like YOU, not conformists to woke ideology. You need to become a new elected Constitutional and Platform Republican (CPR's) on YOUR 244 School Boards and 19 Educational Service Units. Where do you think the next future Legislator or Senator or Congressman or Mayor comes from? _It comes from, WE, the people. _There are over [900 elected Democrats](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=b5f57a0d0d&e=25844e23a8) in Nebraska and in 2017 there were only 504 elected Democrats. In TWO election cycles they gained **[900 elected Democrats](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=2366ad1cfb&e=25844e23a8) and it did not happen by accident, but by neglect and complacency.**
Complacency of our Platform Values.
**[](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=3f61763b95&e=25844e23a8)****AND WORST OF ALL..Neglect of the voices of the PEOPLE within our party. You, the Republican voter, donor, volunteer and many, many local candidates who were never given the support, acknowledgement, or appreciation.**

WHEN YOU DONATE TO THE PARTY, _100%_ OF YOUR DONATION GOES TO **BUILD THE PARTY**! It does NOT go to Federal or State or Legislative candidates. There will be over 100,000 eventual readers of this email and we'd appreciate all 100,000 readers becoming NEGOP+ Booster Members or even donated $150 just ONE time, or coming to our next [Roundtable - Truth in Taxation](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=5ae0156996&e=25844e23a8). [](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=0951e4daa5&e=25844e23a8)
A lot of communication can happen in a week.

In seven days the amount of emails and phone calls have been impressive and the content of the correspondence...very colorful. Constituents (and maybe even you) want the State Party to IMMEDIATELY, yesterday, go make every elected official vote a certain way or budget differently or show support for this cause. I, and the team around me, work every day to make the relationship with all our elected officials stronger so we CAN be your voice. I believe that the elected officials who choose to work WITH the State Party are committed to working with The People. The elected officials that want that relationship, choose YOU the people, over lobbyists, special interests groups, wealthy donors, or echo chambers that perpetuate their legacies.

I encourage you to contact all your elected representatives and ask them to network with the county party and the State Party. I encourage you to highlight the importance of working as a team with the new leadership and new vision of the party. I encourage you to stress the importance of having a State Party that is a voice for the people with a proactive political plan. I encourage this because some of our highest elected officials have declined every offer to connect, every olive branch of support, EVERY coffee with the chairman.

Next week, I'll have a special announcement of an upcoming event with a fabulous guest speaker.

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,
---
|
---
| –Chairman Underwood

October 16, 2023
For More Information contact:
Todd Watson, Political Director NEGOP
Phone: 402-475-2122 **The NEGOP supports the nomination of Jim Jordan for Speaker** The Nebraska Republican Party, in an effort to uphold our Constitution and advance our Platform, enthusiastically encourage our Representatives and citizens to support Representative Jim Jordan for Speaker of the House.

In 2023 Nebraska moved large platform planks forward by advancing a conservative slate of Republican leaders into office. This led to wins in pro-life, second amendment rights, tax cuts, and protecting children. By advancing steadfast conservatives forward, our platform and Constitution(s) win. Congressman Jim Jordan is a ticket to winning in the House.

For too long the Republican Party has been led in the House by individuals with failing conservative scores. The “Liberty Score”, the leading evaluative service of conservative voting records published by Conservative Review, has been a strong indicator of how Representatives vote on legislation that is embodied by our platform and our Constitution.

Kevin McCarthy, our last speaker, has a Liberty Score of 54%. Representative Scalise, a Representative that was mentioned for Speaker, has a Liberty Score of 58%. Former Speaker Paul Ryan had a Liberty Score of 36%. Jim Jordan possesses a 94% Liberty Score based on his votes and leadership on core platform issues. This is a welcome change and will lead to leadership of Constitutional, Conservative, and Republican wins. In the near term, we will have protection from compromising to a radicalized agenda of the far left in power.

We have seen Congress go more to the left with core issues like budgets, lax border control, progressive social agendas, and unchecked executive branches. In addition, Republicans...Americans...Nebraskans are tired of irresponsible budgets, core Republican issues like Obamacare failing, not upholding the Treaty provision of the US Constitution (The Iran Deal being a huge present day disaster), and endless wars without Congressional votes. We need a leader like Congressman Jordan who will not cave to the endless corporate welfare and social welfare demands. We need a leader like Congressman Jordan who understands constitutional responsibility and individual rights. ###****

subject: My reason
body:
Let me explain

| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.

| | My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago – an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something – that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](http://trk.readactnews.-qmp_Xw "Will you join me today and help me save our country?")**
My very best,

body:
I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions.

| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c670205%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rsKGqvUPOBzPoYJTbDqFCg&sysid=1)

| | Dear Friend, [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c670206%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8728rhXtrpgNa33XK856MA&sysid=1)
Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c670207%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Zqd348qhXM4gPiMSdBnPHA&sysid=1)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c670207%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Zqd348qhXM4gPiMSdBnPHA&sysid=1)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

Friends,
On Saturday, Louisiana held elections for its legislative branch, as well as their state-wide offices. Unlike most states, there are no partisan primaries in Louisiana. It's a "jungle" primary with every single candidate on the ballot. If a candidate gets over 50% of the vote, they win. If not, the top two finishers head to a runoff.
The most talked about story of the night was how Republican Attorney General Jeff Landry became the Governor-Elect of the Bayou State on Saturday, flipping the governor's mansion to Republican after eight years of Democrat John Bel Edwards.
But not only did Republicans take back the executive branch, the Louisiana Freedom Caucus, which we only formed back in March, made massive gains.
For starters, **every single one of our incumbents were overwhelmingly re-elected** , such as Reps. Beryl Amadee, Danny McCormick, Kathy Edmonston, and Raymond Crews.
In addition, Freedom Caucus members Chairman Rep. Alan Seabaugh and Rep. Blake Miguez were both elected to the Louisiana State Senate, expanding the caucus' ranks into the upper chamber of the state legislature. Establishment Republicans spent over $700K supporting Rep. Miguez's opponent and he ended up with over 60% of the vote!
The LAFC PAC also supported several candidates who pledged to join the LA Freedom Caucus that came out victorious as well. In total, they supported 31 candidates with 18 outright wins, 7 heading to runoffs, and just 6 losses.
Senator-Elect Miguez's ballot measure for a constitutional amendment to ban Zuckerbucks and foreign money in state elections also overwhelmingly passed, making LA the first state to enact such an amendment.
With just one legislative session under its belt, the LA Freedom Caucus has already made a ton of noise in the state. Now that their state has a conservative governor, the caucus has even more power to deliver victories for limited government and freedom.
Saturday's elections showed the LAFC will be here for a long time to come.
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**

# Did you hear the good news?
---
| |
---|---
Dear Friends,

On July 30, I launched my grassroots campaign for U.S. Congress to defeat the incumbent Democrat Susan Wild in 2024, whose support of extreme-left policies clearly does not reflect the values of our local community. I am running to restore the American Dream for our families, our children, and our grandchildren by strengthening small and family-owned businesses; establishing a strong border; supporting our veterans, law enforcement, and first responders; and ending out of control government spending.

In these the first months of my campaign, I was humbled by the expansive community support I have received - a testament to the fact that many believe that my campaign represents the best opportunity to defeat Susan Wild. While the $100,773 our grassroots campaign raised in two short months is impressive for a first-time candidate, it unfortunately was not enough to keep pace with Susan Wild, who raised $430,000 over the last three months from special interest groups and liberal California elitists.
It is an honor that community leaders like Lisa Scheller, Congressman Dan Meuser, and others are supporting my campaign because they believe I am the best person to beat Susan Wild. I reflect the values of our district and will fight for--working class families, supporting family-owned and small businesses, and keeping our communities safe. PA-7 is clearly a winnable seat. Following redistricting, which added Carbon and Monroe Counties, the 7th Congressional District is now rated an R+2 district. That makes this one of the most highly competitive seats in 2024.
But in order to defeat Susan Wild, I need your help to share my positive message with voters. This is a grassroots campaign, every contribution, large or small, brings us one dollar closer to our goal.
May I count on your support? Your generosity is greatly appreciated.

Thank you,

Maria

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=734%2E135344%2EjDguSm)

Friends --
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and his longest serving cabinet secretary.
The DeVos family has supported opponents of mine in the past, and it looks like they’re ready to double down on this senate race.
**Republican Mike Rogers' latest FEC report was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family -- contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day, just before the September 30th deadline.**
Mike Rogers has already started to see a flood of support from deep-pocketed Republican donors like Betsy DeVos, corporate PACs, and Super PACs who will all spend millions of dollars on his behalf in order to flip Michigan red. In 2020, the DeVos family contributed over $1.6 million to candidates and PACs which have spent over $10 million to super PACs to influence races like ours.
So these contributions are just the beginning of the support Mike Rogers will receive from this powerful family.
But this campaign has something Mike Rogers' campaign lacks: lots and lots of regular people giving what they can, when they can.
Just one peek behind-the-curtain of Mike Rogers' FEC report shows he raised less than 5% of his money from individuals making small-dollar donations.
By contrast, the majority of the donations we receive come from people contributing significantly smaller donations than the DeVos family made to Mike Rogers: Our average email donation was $26 last quarter.
And what you may not know is that the single greatest source of individual donations to our campaign is the response to emails like this.
That’s why I would love to earn your support today. [**Your help using this link to make a $3 contribution to my campaign for United States Senate would be a great rebuke to the DeVos support.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231017-1-30&t=2&akid=734%2E135344%2EjDguSm)**

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

body:
I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions.

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24245%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=05ODwZSLH584Q2tYG4Lz5w&sysid=1)

| | Dear Friend, [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24246%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9HUzKBISN9yIIeUd4Kz43w&sysid=1)
Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24247%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IdSZ%2fZgrJ46wSgKt63lVqw&sysid=1)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24247%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IdSZ%2fZgrJ46wSgKt63lVqw&sysid=1)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

Greg Stamps | Online Development
Hoover Institution | Stanford University

---

| | | Tanya Chutkan, the federal judge overseeing Trump’s case on his attempts to overthrow the 2020 election, issued a gag order on Trump, limiting what he can say about Special Counsel Jack Smith and the case. [Add your name to thank Judge Chutkan for issuing the gag order >> ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3e5ae745-4400-4848-aa6e-edb86a0dd612/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump is being held accountable for his threats, lies, and attempts to intimidate those connected with the trial.The gag order “[restricts](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfc86d5e3-00ed-4fac-a3a9-308445ae5024/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump’s ability to publicly target court personnel, potential witnesses, or the special counsel and his staff.” This is great news – Trump could now be punished if he violates the order. We want to thank Judge Chutkan for taking this important step and protecting those involved in the case. Make no mistake, this took guts, and Judge Chutkan deserves credit, and thanks. [Add your name: Thank Judge Tanya Chutkan for issuing a gag order on Trump >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T267d2141-6c9a-4dfc-b328-6b35203ea3b4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| Peter, What are your plans tomorrow evening? **Join us** **_TOMORROW_ , Wednesday October 18th, for Cocktails For A Cause at the Ivy Inn** (located at 248 Nassau Street, Princeton, NJ 08542). The special evening will benefit The Nicholas Hudanish Foundation, all tips will be donated directly to the cause. **Our guest bartender for the evening will be Bill Spadea!**

---
|
---
**That's right, Bill Spadea himself will be crafting cocktails for you throughout the evening!** There's no need to purchase a ticket, just show up tomorrow evening at the Ivy Inn in Princeton between 6:00-8:00PM, sit back, and enjoy a refreshing cocktail for a great cause!
To learn more about the Nicholas Hudanish Foundation, [**click here.**](https://xtz223.keap-link008.com/v2/click/ed8715307741c2b687ee9789752aaa23/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnCXx65C3EAnRPESdY3G3XLLZZR0zE_972wd1Keg687zP8M4IJJAhZRxiuNDV9wNwwIhKaimQEoXEqsfWj0Iv8BxoJB6XRnUa4vFr-A3cx1409x2gQQuLbNaLJM_K5a7IytySmhl74z9PEH486WqRFTBNP8XiJCk9W3cLMZlO3BtxaVvR1jSWr4l07Lp9389QVrVqWFt3nKFs673qkDOSCmfKHKyLaS2Qvx6Ri-FpnG6HtGeG)

| The Nicholas Hudanish Foundation was founded by Tom Hudanish, a former Perth Amboy Police Officer, after losing his son Nicholas to addiction. For the past several years, he's been running this Foundation in his son's honor. Tom has stepped up in a big way to help those battling addiction by getting involved before there's a problem. A mission of the Foundation is to educate and empower kids to prevent addiction before it ever starts. The Nicholas Hudanish Foundation works directly with schools to provide resources to keep kids out of trouble and educate and inform young people about preventing addiction.
**Join us for a night to remember, all while backing a powerful cause.** See you tomorrow, The Common Sense Action Team

| It’s time for Common Sense ideas and policies to dominate the landscape instead of the vicious and totally counter-productive partisan attacks that only serve to embolden the elite power brokers.You’re a part of the Common Sense Club because you know that we need RESULTS from our government, NOT RHETORIC. Many arrogant, elitist elected officials crushed our way of life during the misguided, unnecessary and deadly lockdowns. Now it’s time to hold them accountable for their actions, ignorance and negligence. The tide is turning, and today is only STEP ONE!

This year’s elections provide a can’t-miss opportunity to support small businesses and families with fiscally responsible policies, restore an education system that puts students and parents over the radical agenda of the NJEA elites, and protect and preserve our civil, economic, and medical liberty.
We believe that our government should serve the people and provide the expected services that we’re paying for! It’s time for government to function as a public service, not a propaganda tool for radicals.
We believe in REDUCING tax burdens on working families AND empowering the skilled trades and small businesses.
We believe our schools should reject Critical Race Theory and the sexualized curricula. It’s time to empower parents and stop the NJEA once and for all.
I hope you’ll join me TODAY as we discuss the results of this year’s critical elections.
If you want to stand with me against the out-of-touch career politicians who are taking New Jersey down the wrong path and help restore Common Sense, you’re in the right place!Please join me during my show tonight, call in to share your thoughts, and watch the results of this year’s elections live as they come in!
Together, we can keep working to restore Common Sense and save New Jersey and America.
Thank you,Bill Spadea

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

During the critical 2020 election, former President Donald Trump’s campaign targeted Pennsylvania in their attacks to dismantle our democracy by filing a frivolous lawsuit alleging Philadelphia election officials violated state law while tallying ballots.

clean_body: What happens on Nov. 7 will shape 2024. = | Fellow activist, According to USA Today , the judges and justice Pennsylvanians elect in November could shape the 2024 presidential election. During the critical 2020 election, former President Donald Trump’s campaign targeted Pennsylvania in their attacks to dismantle our democracy by filing a frivolous lawsuit alleging Philadelphia election officials violated state law while tallying ballots. Here’s why that matters now: Thanks to the Pennsylvania Supreme Court, that lawsuit was dismissed. But with 2024 just around the corner, more attacks on voting rights and our freedom to vote will surely happen again. On November 7th (or before when voting by mail), voters will head to the polls in Pennsylvania to vote for a State Supreme Court Justice, two new Superior Court judges, a new Commonwealth Court judge, and several local/municipal positions. Our PA courts can and will issue rulings on some of the Commonwealth’s most fundamental issues,including our very freedom to vote. Peter, it’s Shannon Watts, the founder of Moms Demand Action. After the Sandy Hook tragedy, I started a Facebook group dedicated to reducing gun violence in America. Since then, tens of thousands of advocates have joined our movement to end gun violence. _And we just had a major win._ **Under the leadership of Rep. Maxwell Frost, and the continued promise from the Biden-Harris administration, we now have a dedicated Office of Gun Violence Prevention in the White House.** This is a significant turning point in the movement for gun violence prevention. **We CAN and WILL continue making progress to end gun violence and save lives through good policy – _but only if we re-elect leaders like Maxwell Frost.**_ [So I have to ask: Will you rush a $27 donation to Maxwell Frost’s campaign, so we can continue this critical work to make our communities safer? >>](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/yEg-MlsNiEDdeIiGOuzPvA~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRnETJCP0TPaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDIzMTAxN19lbV9mcl9iMV9TaGFubm9uX1dhdHRzX2VuJmFtb3VudD0yNyZjZG1jPTJXdFpyMmhLaDV0cTZMUFN1Rkw0NllYemEwTiZyZWZjb2RlMj0yV3RacjJoS2g1dHE2TFBTdUZMNDZZWHphME4mcmVmY29kZWNkbWM9Mld0WnIyaEtoNXRxNkxQU3VGTDQ2WVh6YTBOVwNzcGNCCmUgQq0uZQ4sdz5SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAABp) Maxwell stepped up to be an advocate for gun violence prevention after the Sandy Hook tragedy, and he’s brought that fight all the way to D.C. as a member of Congress. Without these strong advocates fighting for us in Congress, we lose the opportunity to continue our progress, Peter. That’s why we MUST rally behind Maxwell to ensure he can continue this critical work that will save lives. But the gun lobby is already spending millions attacking gun safety legislation _and_ campaigns like Maxwell’s that are dedicated to combating the gun violence epidemic in our country. **We won’t let the NRA win. Dear Peter, **As I’m sure you know, far too many career politicians in D.C. are desperate to cling to their power by any means necessary. And left unchecked, they hold their power for****DECADES****! ** That’s why I am sponsoring legislation to add a Term Limits Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, and why I am hopeful you will **_[support this effort with your voice today.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0e0244ece14746f8894137321c17243e&_e=t-N3alJ4Cn-h-a7l66rnrmRGeFKCGh65cCL5P8xjRkeVgQDpFXQONrop1rfT2M4cGv5iMIgWackZbTVdD0H9vTbdyPwBdFLkEPw08twMA83m0GQIPlDT8bi3aLlGmNBbMo1Ix5yG2a04wEadUE9eKSCar23uVsw2cm7ZRHDEG_BvVbEyRfB-4cbMmdIqF5LJ9MGAR_ERxWuNiC7q5AkvRYoQBKvzVFaXtqE3XoQnyRXP48U2eZj0zXuMBpSV_VXsnrfOSR0GhG1ekxTL2DFBv-PV4yLAuO0DEX6y7zo3_iaFomC3XQHp5QKCl0bcn6otN39AJIaOT5RHU9uSGxkUhae7-CSuFRIj38IjTeuzvecdtTlHHhPnTBV0Y01eqwVSWcse57fQpKAiq92l1FrhMw%3D%3D)_ ** Under my Term Limits Amendment, lawmakers in D.C. would: ✓ Serve a _**MAXIMUM of three terms**_ in the House or _**just two terms**_ in the Senate; ✓ Be focused on their _**constituents**_ , _NOT_ the lobbyists who fund their campaigns; and ✓ _**LEAVE OFFICE**_ after they reach their term limit, returning to their home states and letting their voters elect a new “citizen-legislator” to represent them!

Every survey conducted recently shows **at least 70%** of the American people support **putting term limits on Congress. ** That’s why career politicians like Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer and President Biden (with their 88 combined years “serving” the American people) want to shut my Term Limits Amendment down before it builds any momentum. And that’s why I am so anxious to know that you _**[supported our fight FOR TERM LIMITS.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0e0244ece14746f8894137321c17243e&_e=t-N3alJ4Cn-h-a7l66rnrmRGeFKCGh65cCL5P8xjRkeVgQDpFXQONrop1rfT2M4cGv5iMIgWackZbTVdD0H9vTbdyPwBdFLkEPw08twMA83m0GQIPlDT8bi3aLlGmNBbMo1Ix5yG2a04wEadUE9eKSCar23uVsw2cm7ZRHDEG_BvVbEyRfB-4cbMmdIqF5LJ9MGAR_ERxWuNiC7q5AkvRYoQBKvzVFaXtqE3XoQnyRV0allSdfhoxgRKTSa2RvXPEM99SNw21hp0d34IgvEeGC7sIX0GXvvadsnlQQzkDHZ7PL6egqAi0eErl-4fo3fnM5pOVtj71UAC8vDIgv-aUeK4jCyjW0Mx-HinE46Kp07tzkmuaVMxUOPQslDXmimsrEiqVUtZUaNIgMvITNw5-w%3D%3D)**_ While I am not a career politician myself, I’ve been in D.C. long enough to know that nothing moves here unless it is pushed – **HARD** – by grassroots citizens writing, calling, and emailing their lawmakers in numbers so huge they can’t be ignored. My friends at Club for Growth have already done a lot of the work here, typing up petitions and gathering signatures in support. Club employees will combine them, with thousands more being mailed in by concerned citizens in your state, and deliver them all to Capitol Hill at a moment of maximum impact as I fight on the Senate floor to drive my term limits bill forward. **There needs to be a HUGE stack of PETITIONS on every lawmaker’s desk**! _**[And if you agree, I urge you to give a voluntary contribution of $25, $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or more to Club for Growth, helping them expand this nationwide petition drive before the career politicians bury this effort in big-government liberalism.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0e0244ece14746f8894137321c17243e&_e=t-N3alJ4Cn-h-a7l66rnrmRGeFKCGh65cCL5P8xjRkeVgQDpFXQONrop1rfT2M4cGv5iMIgWackZbTVdD0H9vTbdyPwBdFLkEPw08twMA83Pre5lgjzMu0XfyWcjqPzWCJZoK9yOuFm6JSEhAI918_7nHOPoCRwegr-LBEcQ7YzHUEYwdkWqmvDcl3nXxcdk1_L3sRA9ZN5DauM4u403VhRQBmlUudsPnD5bFoYAwBvIJjym4DBcH2zHU_gWkeVypg1-78HvDQVcCcnmrYhiu_P-07_8bUudUOwT74TuWkYESMCVUnowlyjqgNRTMUTPssMWE0A_IdpCdbzWlTEgM6msRFJW-SwntCFzDAXlxZ4VBYDWMcGRZDBg3F4OrZzY)**_ Club for Growth is among America’s most hard-hitting and effective organizations fighting for low taxes, small government, and economic freedom, and they are 100% reliant on donations sent in by other fiscal conservatives like you across the country. So, I hope you will be generous AND prompt with your response because the fact of the matter is that **career politicians are a direct threat to free enterprise in the USA****.** You see, when a politician’s only concern is getting re-elected, he becomes ad _dicted to_ _the huge PAC donations_ that come from D.C. lobbyists and all kinds of special interest groups representing various industries, unions, or ideological factions. As you can imagine, when those lobbyists offer money to a politician’s campaign, they do so with the expectation that they will be “repaid the favor,” and the favor they almost always want is a new spending program, a new regulation, a new tax, or a new loophole that gives their client a special advantage over the competition. _What do all these D.C.-based favors have in common?_ **They reduce your liberty! They increase your tax burden! They force you to****pay higher prices for everything from college tuition to electricity to groceries.** That’s why, if we are EVER going to get government under control, we’ve got to break this vicious cycle of politicians taxing, spending, and regulating their way to long careers in Washington, D.C. With term limits in place, all of a sudden, you’d see elected officials with more interest in getting something done for the people during their short time in office, and less interest in doing big-government favors for the lobbyists they need to win elections every two years. Nothing could be more critical to the future of American freedom and prosperity. I should know. My first year in the Senate, I led the charge to defund ObamaCare, even launching a filibuster to try and stop that terrible law from sending the cost of health insurance skyrocketing upwards. I campaigned against Obama’s big-government policies, and I believed I owed it to the voters to try and stop his government healthcare takeover. You should have heard all the objections I got from my “experienced” colleagues: _“Ted, you haven’t been here long enough, this isn’t how things work . . . you gotta cut_ _deals with the big spenders to get things you want... you need to learn how we do business here... you can stand on principle some other time, I’ve got an election coming up.”_ And on and on it went. And you know what happened. You also know that if we keep seeing the same politicians decade after decade, pushing the same tax-and-spend policies over and over again, we’ll **NEVER** solve our country’s problems. _**[That’s why I’m urging you to support the Club for Growth to ensure our message is amplified to as many Americans as possible.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0e0244ece14746f8894137321c17243e&_e=t-N3alJ4Cn-h-a7l66rnrmRGeFKCGh65cCL5P8xjRkeVgQDpFXQONrop1rfT2M4cGv5iMIgWackZbTVdD0H9vTbdyPwBdFLkEPw08twMA83m0GQIPlDT8bi3aLlGmNBbMo1Ix5yG2a04wEadUE9eKSCar23uVsw2cm7ZRHDEG_BvVbEyRfB-4cbMmdIqF5LJ9MGAR_ERxWuNiC7q5AkvRYoQBKvzVFaXtqE3XoQnyRULAnyS6svqwM5tJRz_YOGOBiawOMZbFNek-dNlbM142PDrVi3mT2cduiwDYYF-PiGWP8J6MW6_kJASiPnBkdbybbWwozDR5TKcbRyowgACi6SRB1La5xO4bnIusZ7uu2VZUNY4P-vVaI65tV6FyDxtO9TDJh8zn0qyMdYc5SPV5Q%3D%3D)**_ In case you aren’t familiar with their work, the Club for Growth is a national network of over 250,000 pro-growth, limited-government Americans who share in the belief that prosperity and opportunity come from economic freedom, **NOT** central planning and high tax rates. For the past two decades, the Club for Growth has emerged as one of the few organizations willing and able to take on any Member of Congress (regardless of Party) on policy who fails to uphold basic economic conservative principles. Their policy experts worked closely with me and the Trump Administration for four years as we cut taxes, rolled back Obama-era regulations and ignited the biggest jobs boom in American history before the coronavirus pandemic hit us. During all key debates on legislation in Congress, the Club exerts maximum pressure on lawmakers to vote like free-market-limited government conservatives, and they aren’t shy about holding big-spending politicians accountable by publicizing their voting records using everything from TV ads to social media to direct mail. The bottom line is that the Club for Growth is among the most influential pro-freedom, pro-growth groups in D.C. This push for Term Limits is a huge priority for the Club, and of course, the spending-addicted career politicians in Washington will do everything they can to make it go away. So, you cannot afford to waste _even a minute_. Not with scores of career politicians and their cronies _plotting to put their decades of congressional “experience” to work enacting the most expensive and socialistic agenda we’ve seen in modern history._ **That’s why I hope you will include the most generous gift you can afford to help expand this nationwide petition drive.** The Club’s goal is to collect 250,000 petitions so that they can apply huge pressure on the House and Senate over the next 90 days. clean_body: This would be a huge, lasting change for government in America, returning us to the vision our Founders had when they created our republic. | | | Please see a note from our sponsors. If you would like to unsubscribe, please visit this . Dear Peter, As I’m sure you know, far too many career politicians in D.C. are desperate to cling to their power by any means necessary. And left unchecked, they hold their power forDECADES! That’s why I am sponsoring legislation to add a Term Limits Amendment to the U.S. Constitution, and why I am hopeful you will Under my Term Limits Amendment, lawmakers in D.C. would: ✓ Serve a MAXIMUM of three terms in the House or just two terms in the Senate; ✓ Be focused on their constituents , NOT the lobbyists who fund their campaigns; and ✓ LEAVE OFFICE after they reach their term limit, returning to their home states and letting their voters elect a new “citizen-legislator” to represent them! | | This would be a huge, lasting change for government in America, returning us to the vision our Founders had when they created our republic. No kings, no entrenched ruling elite, just free-born citizens managing our own affairs. It’s also hugely popular. Every survey conducted recently shows at least 70% of the American people support putting term limits on Congress. That’s why career politicians like Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer and President Biden (with their 88 combined years “serving” the American people) want to shut my Term Limits Amendment down before it builds any momentum. And that’s why I am so anxious to know that you While I am not a career politician myself, I’ve been in D.C. long enough to know that nothing moves here unless it is pushed – HARD – by grassroots citizens writing, calling, and emailing their lawmakers in numbers so huge they can’t be ignored. My friends at Club for Growth have already done a lot of the work here, typing up petitions and gathering signatures in support. Club employees will combine them, with thousands more being mailed in by concerned citizens in your state, and deliver them all to Capitol Hill at a moment of maximum impact as I fight on the Senate floor to drive my term limits bill forward. There needs to be a HUGE stack of PETITIONS on every lawmaker’s desk! Club for Growth is among America’s most hard-hitting and effective organizations fighting for low taxes, small government, and economic freedom, and they are 100% reliant on donations sent in by other fiscal conservatives like you across the country. So, I hope you will be generous AND prompt with your response because the fact of the matter is that career politicians are a direct threat to free enterprise in the USA. You see, when a politician’s only concern is getting re-elected, he becomes ad dicted to the huge PAC donations that come from D.C. lobbyists and all kinds of special interest groups representing various industries, unions, or ideological factions. As you can imagine, when those lobbyists offer money to a politician’s campaign, they do so with the expectation that they will be “repaid the favor,” and the favor they almost always want is a new spending program, a new regulation, a new tax, or a new loophole that gives their client a special advantage over the competition. What do all these D.C.-based favors have in common? They reduce your liberty! They increase your tax burden! They force you topay higher prices for everything from college tuition to electricity to groceries. That’s why, if we are EVER going to get government under control, we’ve got to break this vicious cycle of politicians taxing, spending, and regulating their way to long careers in Washington, D.C. With term limits in place, all of a sudden, you’d see elected officials with more interest in getting something done for the people during their short time in office, and less interest in doing big-government favors for the lobbyists they need to win elections every two years. Nothing could be more critical to the future of American freedom and prosperity. I should know. My first year in the Senate, I led the charge to defund ObamaCare, even launching a filibuster to try and stop that terrible law from sending the cost of health insurance skyrocketing upwards. I campaigned against Obama’s big-government policies, and I believed I owed it to the voters to try and stop his government healthcare takeover. You should have heard all the objections I got from my “experienced” colleagues: “Ted, you haven’t been here long enough, this isn’t how things work . . . you gotta cut deals with the big spenders to get things you want... you need to learn how we do business here... you can stand on principle some other time, I’ve got an election coming up.” And on and on it went. And you know what happened. You also know that if we keep seeing the same politicians decade after decade, pushing the same tax-and-spend policies over and over again, we’ll NEVER solve our country’s problems. In case you aren’t familiar with their work, the Club for Growth is a national network of over 250,000 pro-growth, limited-government Americans who share in the belief that prosperity and opportunity come from economic freedom, NOT central planning and high tax rates. For the past two decades, the Club for Growth has emerged as one of the few organizations willing and able to take on any Member of Congress (regardless of Party) on policy who fails to uphold basic economic conservative principles. Their policy experts worked closely with me and the Trump Administration for four years as we cut taxes, rolled back Obama-era regulations and ignited the biggest jobs boom in American history before the coronavirus pandemic hit us. During all key debates on legislation in Congress, the Club exerts maximum pressure on lawmakers to vote like free-market-limited government conservatives, and they aren’t shy about holding big-spending politicians accountable by publicizing their voting records using everything from TV ads to social media to direct mail. The bottom line is that the Club for Growth is among the most influential pro-freedom, pro-growth groups in D.C. This push for Term Limits is a huge priority for the Club, and of course, the spending-addicted career politicians in Washington will do everything they can to make it go away. So, you cannot afford to waste even a minute. Not with scores of career politicians and their cronies plotting to put their decades of congressional “experience” to work enacting the most expensive and socialistic agenda we’ve seen in modern history. That’s why I hope you will include the most generous gift you can afford to help expand this nationwide petition drive. The Club’s goal is to collect 250,000 petitions so that they can apply huge pressure on the House and Senate over the next 90 days. Club for Growth President David McIntosh tells me it will cost $.50 for each petition collected. So, your gift of will allow them to get signatures from another 50 Americans. But the Club for Growth will need to raise $125,000 in order to meet their goal, so if you can afford an especially generous gift of , ,**** or even , please send it ASAP. My friend, for too long, members of Congress have abused their power and ignored the will of the American people. Term limits on federal lawmakers offer a solution to the brokenness we are seeing in Washington, D.C. So please donate to our fight today. Peter, Remember when President Biden tweeted that "Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans are a threat to the very soul of this country"? It looks like the FBI took him seriously. A shocking new report from Newsweek just confirmed what many have feared: **The FBI is tagging Trump supporters as potential domestic terrorists.** In October 2022, the FBI created a shadowy new category for classifying domestic extremists, “AGAVEE-Other.” It stands for "anti-government, anti-authority violent extremism," and they have all but admitted it’s really a code word for “MAGA.” Meanwhile, pro-life crisis pregnancy centers are firebombed, our cities are looted, and law enforcement barely bats an eye. | | I woke up today to find a hit piece on me by Brian Holmes from "The 208."

According to him, I'm a racist for using the term "illegal aliens" and he's got a bone to pick with me because I'm a marketer who also uses A.I. for image creation (werid).

He's also mad about a tweet I posted a year ago.

Why?

All because **I put America first and oppose amnesty for illegal aliens**.

Alright, let's cut through the noise and get straight to the point. Brian Holmes wants to come at me for putting America first and having strong opinions on illegal immigration. Fine, let's break it down.

First off, do I need a PhD in agriculture or a sit-down with every Idaho farmer to have an opinion on national security and the labor force? Nope. I've been around farms all my life—dairy, avocado, walnut, you name it. I grew up around dairy farms in the LARGEST ag state in the country!

So yeah, I've got some skin in the game, and I've actually talked to farmers, unlike Holmes who's too scared to even show their faces on his show (they had a shadow guy claiming to be a farmer instead).

Let's talk about illegal immigration...

Some people think it's the government's job to roll out the red carpet for foreign labor. Nope. that just creates more problems by incentivizing illegal entry and behavior:
* It's a free invite for illegal aliens
* It screws over American workers by driving down wages
* It's a security nightmare (e.g. human trafficking and drugs like fentanyl flooding in)

And about those "temporary" visa programs? Spoiler alert: They're not temporary. Most illegal aliens in the U.S. are here from visa overstays. they come and never leave. That's a fact.

Holmes wants to throw around terms like "racist dog whistle" for saying "illegal aliens."

**But you know what's really racist?**

Exploiting an entire people group for low-wage slave labor and making sweeping generalizations about an entire race.

Don't get it twisted... this isn't about some feel-good "guest worker" program. This is about importing a workforce that jeopardizes our national security and puts American workers LAST.

That's not just bad policy—it's straight-up un-American.

So, instead of crying on a TV show and playing word games, let's focus on the big issues. Congress needs to step up to control illegal entry and drug flow. Period. The idea that we should bend over backward for industries wanting cheap, foreign labor 365 days a year is ludicrous. It's time to enforce the laws and protect our borders.

That's it.

No sugarcoating.

This is about keeping America safe and putting Americans first. And if that ruffles some feathers, then so be it.

Cheers,

Brian

| Welcome to our campaign's first email newsletter! In each newsletter we'll include information about upcoming events, my thoughts on pressing issues, some photos from the campaign trail, and how you help us win this crucial U.S. House seat.

If you know someone who would be interested in learning more about my campaign to flip NV-03, please [forward this email](https://us14.forward-to-friend.com/forward?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=5db2501c31&e=fc26432468) to them.

# _**On the Campaign Trail**_

Team Johnson has been busy at work on the campaign trail! Here are some of the events we attended this month.

**Reed House Party:**
Two of our fantastic supporters, Bob and Kelli Reed, opened their home to host a Meet and Greet with Drew! The house was filled with neighbors and friends who had an opportunity to share their thoughts with Drew, listen to his platform, and learn more about the race.
---
|
---
---
|
# LVMPD National Night Out:
Drew and Sarah joined LVMPD for their National Night Out in Downtown Summerlin, right in the heart of CD3! The National Night Out is an annual community-building campaign that promotes police-community partnerships and neighborhood camaraderie.
---
|
---
|
# Asian Economic Alliance Meeting:
Drew and Sarah were honored to help recognize Yaling "Cathy" Qin for completing her very successful first year as President of the Las Vegas-based America Asia Economic Alliance (AAEA). The Las Vegas Chinese News Network featured this event.
---
|
---
---
|
# Las Vegas Conservative Town Hall group:
Drew was excited to speak for a second time at the Las Vegas Conservative Town Hall! He shared stories from his 25 years of fighting for individual liberty and limited government.
---
|
---
|
---
