# _Issue of the Day_ :
Just over a week ago, **hundreds of Israelis were killed** as Hamas militants carried out an unprecedented, multifront attack on Israel, firing over 2,500 rockets as dozens of Hamas fighters infiltrated the heavily fortified border by air, land, and sea, catching the country off-guard on the 50th anniversary of the Yom Kippur War.

Since then, **over 1,000 more innocent Israelis have lost their lives** due to these egregious attacks. Americans must stand united with Israel, our great friend and ally in the Middle East. Our first priority should be to ensure Israel has all the resources it needs to neutralize the terrorists and rescue the Israeli civilians who have been taken hostage. Secondly, we must **hold the Biden administration** and **Congressional leaders such as Susie Lee accountable.** They must answer for appeasing Tehran and granting the regime unprecedented revenues through ransom and illicit oil sales. This money is directly funding these terrorists to attack Israel. When I am in Congress, I will stop the flow of our tax dollars to terrorist groups and anti-Israel organizations. I wish I could say the same for my opponents. One of my Republican primary opponents, **Heidi Kasama, directed thousands of dollars in PAC contributions to pro-HAMAS extremists** in Congress, including Ilhan Omar and Rashid Tlaib.

The Democrat incumbent Susie Lee was endorsed by the Democratic Socialists of America, who recently came under fire after [expressing their "steadfast solidarity" with HAMAS.](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=4c0ec34a7a&e=fc26432468) Instead of condemning this outlandish statement, Susie Lee was as quiet as a church mouse, despite several other Democrat elected officials denouncing the DSA and their disgusting rhetoric.

[Learn more about my background and priorities.](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=cf99e1877a&e=fc26432468)

| | Dear Friend, [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zpn68uul84kh7o5epqsok1g5lubb1p8vrituds88_rp22sh2s8i66p77cljmcpr2c1h2bs)
Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdf64ckqjjijj5pfgps2a68i5veio7t90llerspg_rp22sh2s8i66p77cljmcpr2c1h2bs)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9k15nhjvigi9hk3mgvd58ab41q7cc4qcgrqpho0_rp22sh2s8i66p77cljmcpr2c1h2bs)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

Hoover Institution | Stanford University

* * *
**NEWS**
* * *

**Fundraising Quarter Ends - We’re Winning Big!**
The critical first fundraising reports for the campaigns are in and we’re leading big. Here are some highlights:

\- We raised more money than both the other candidates - and we did it in less time as we entered the race later than anyone else.
\- We ended with more cash-on-hand than both the other candidates COMBINED.
\- While the majority of our campaign donors live in the 7th District, 80% of Maria Montero’s money came from outside the district.

Why are these facts important? Because they send a strong signal that our campaign has the support of real people here in the 7th District AND that we will have the resources to beat Susan Wild.
* * *
**Lehigh County Commissioner Jeffery Dutt**
More and more trusted local elected officials continue to join our team, and this week I’m proud to announce the latest: Lehigh County Commissioner Jeffrey Dutt!

In endorsing our campaign, he said "Now more than ever, our community deserves a Representative in Washington who will do what's right for our families. Ryan Mackenzie always has, and I know he always will. He's the best choice for Congress."

* * *
**Carbon County BBQ Supporting Local Candidates**
Over the weekend, I was proud to continue working to support our local 2023 Republican candidates - this time in Carbon County. Their BBQ Fundraiser was a great success and I was happy to take part.

* * *
**Ann Flood Event**
I took some time this week to visit Northampton County and speak at my House colleague Ann Flood’s event about the importance of sending a proven fighter to Washington to stand up for our principles and values. Ann is a strong leader in Harrisburg for her community and I was happy to support her.

As we approach the final push for this year’s election and I continue to work hard at helping our local Republican candidates, I hope you will take some time to help them, too. Dear Friend,

It is with a heavy heart that I reach out to you. We have all witnessed the recent horrific events in Israel. Some of my fellow ambassadors and I have sent a letter to Congress (https://mcusercontent.com/99d251bf9c4705c4eb727273b/files/cff629d2-8e54-b173-5b7a-ca82740ad116/Amb_letter_on_Israel_crisis_FINAL.pdf) urging support for our closest Middle East ally, Israel.

The terror in Israel perpetrated by members of Hamas, backed by Iran, with their perfect air, land, and sea siege on Israel, immediately caused me to think of our southern border. More than 100 known terrorists and ISIS fighters have been apprehended at our southern border. We only catch 60% of those invading our country. This year, 6000 fighting-age Chinese men have been apprehended, according to former National Security Advisor, Robert O’Brien.

Our adversaries see weak leadership in America. We should not underestimate the resolve of the Mullahs in Iran and Xi Jinping in Beijing. They see our weakness. What will stop them from planning an assault from within on our homeland? Our three letter agencies have been tasked with defeating climate change and targeting parents at school board meetings, Trump supporters, and traditional Catholics.

What's happening in the Middle East, Ukraine, and China’s threats to Taiwan highlights the urgency to have strong American leadership in order to protect our people. I believe in Ronald Reagan's motto of Peace through Strength. A strong executive helps to protect our homeland.

I hope you will join me in praying for peace and for the families whose loved ones are missing or have been killed in the terror attack in Israel.

I have posted some of my latest media hits, upcoming events and the recent information from America First Policy Institute below.

Warmly,

Carla Sands

** Ready on Day One
------------------------------------------------------------
Last week, we unveiled our America First Transition Project in front of a packed house of friends of the America First movement including more than 250 patriots that were on the Trump team in the last administration. With it, we move one step closer to a conservative administration (and hopefully, many, many more to come) that is prepared to govern long before inauguration day.

It was truly a full-circle moment for me. We began our transition preparedness planning efforts in 2021, a time when many questioned the staying power of the America First movement. But the incredible AFPI family—including you—never did. In 2022, we further elevated that work by creating and hiring a fully operational and specialized team.

Our work, revolutionary in the context of the conservative movement, was born out of acknowledging a harsh reality—and having lived that reality firsthand in the last Administration.

You see, one of the great successes of the progressive left across the past century has been its willingness to go beyond — and often against — the Constitution, establish new structures, and then leverage those new structures against those of us who wish to stay within Constitutional bounds.

As a movement, this puts us conservatives time and again in the position of reacting to those institutions — which we often fail to do, sometimes because we prefer to ignore them, sometimes because their missions are antithetical to our own, and sometimes because we simply do not understand them.

This mechanism unfolds time and again, and always to the left’s advantage — and always well outside the vision of the American Founders and their understanding of civic equality and self-governance.

Left to its own devices, the great apparatus of the administrative state will subvert, undermine, and seek to end the lawful and Constitutional governance that is the American birthright. We cannot overstate this: their efforts are the end of America. We also must be clear, for anyone naive enough to believe that all this is a singular, specific, and discrete reaction to President Donald J. Trump: every conservative President, every conservative administration, and every conservative agenda may expect to face all of this and more, every time, for all time. They crossed their Rubicon, and there is no going back.

This is why we have the America First Transition Project.

We have it because in the last Administration, we learned how they do what they do — and we are meeting them, and beating them, on their own ground. If they repose in the permanence of their agenda, then we are going to dominate and direct their agenda. If they repose in the permanence of their personnel, then we are going to choose and validate their personnel.

We’ll do all this, and we’ll do it better because we have something they don’t: the truth, the American inheritance, and the endorsement of the American people. That armament is superior to any they may bring to bear — and we have no compunction in using it.

Alongside more than 400 volunteers, including nearly 50 (!!) former agency heads or deputies, we are developing the policies, doing the personnel planning, and documenting the best practices for how to get things done. Our team is developing “Action Plans” for 30 departments and agencies, drafting scores of executive actions, and advancing legislative planning.

To be clear, AFPI cannot be in this arena alone; the task at hand is too large for any organization or even two to handle on their own. We are thankful to our many partners who are assisting in laying the groundwork for January 20, 2025, and we welcome any who wishes to join this righteous fight to save America with open arms. The heart of our work is identifying “how” to drive policy, budget, and personnel changes for the next president. While others are focused on the “who” of personnel, we are focused on personnel planning — the “when,” “where,” “what,” and “why.”

Together, we will be ready on day one.

I want to extend a sincere thank you to all who joined us, both in-person and virtually, for your continued support in this fight for an America First nation — an America our Founding Fathers would be proud of.

Pictured above are some of the key patriots who have been working behind the scenes to launch this crucial project, including Doug Hoelscher, Mike Rigas, Chad Wolf, Hogan Gidley, and former Secretary of the Interior David Bernhardt. Secretary Bernhardt is just one of the 9 former cabinet members we have at AFPI—truly the best of the best working to advance the America First Agenda.

If you missed the event, you can watch it here (http://links.membership.americafirstpolicy.com/u/click?_t=ac87bfcb4c684a5e8a1b1cac873a41e1&_m=f6d8dea6bfab4d579f18305767afa8a5&_e=lU2xIRta9Jgj1Nzt2c9a7q53wSHDLZv66lV0D6VFbKVByrMjSsSj4L9npzCiLLfu1HGbj_LJeXOUpQagaFjOb1nf1OADiwK9PLPqXC4S4RQDI54x7Ll8Ayzvxey0lBYoeowBiPH3MRvpVeMxxwuX3_4TLWT4aQWmaJlb6zWVpuspYErlcpd-w4mG0zgzlOQDmQJDtnSPHsxcAq0gSvW67tMdWMg3NoetqOyp9K83ePxrYDE1u3zhK71TYA-FLftwe-Z23pcHX31HLDCNNznolgWOAPwaMxJKizDIOWTfv3Y%3D) . ** We are the Administrative State’s Nightmare
------------------------------------------------------------
Speaking of dismantling the administrative state and restoring America to its original vision, there may be no better expert in the country than our very own James Sherk, a former member of our White House Domestic Policy Council team, who is the brains behind the Schedule F executive order signed in the Trump Administration.

Schedule F enabled agencies to dismiss intransigent or poorly performing career employees from policy-influencing positions. In doing so, it allowed the president to hold key portions of the federal bureaucracy accountable and ensure that policy was made by the American people’s elected representatives.

Of course, Biden did away with Schedule F almost immediately upon taking officeproviding more power to faceless bureaucrats, expanding the ever-growing swamp. It’s a deliberate and calculated attempt to keep and misuse their power as they please, with no repercussions whatsoever.

A key part of our America First Transition Project is preparing the executive actions as well as legislation that will return power to those who are actually elected by the American people — and, therefore, can be held accountable.

And we have caught the attention of the Swamp. A recent CNN piece opens:

** “The Biden administration is seeking to strengthen protections for federal workers as a host of Republican candidates, including frontrunner Donald Trump, make reducing and altering the federal workforce a key component of their campaigns. In a new proposed rule, the administration seeks to clarify civil service protections for federal workers and make it more difficult to reclassify them into a category where they could be stripped of certain protections.”
------------------------------------------------------------
Only in Washington do people believe the bureaucracy needs to be held less accountable.

Fortunately, as James Sherk told the New York Times, “The Biden administration can, if they want, make removing intransigent or poorly performing senior bureaucrats harder on themselves. The next administration can just as easily rescind those restrictions. With regards to reissuing Schedule F, this proposed rule would be a speed bump, but nothing more.”

Rest assured; we will be ready to take on the Swamp head-on.

You can read more on Schedule F and its significance here (http://links.membership.americafirstpolicy.com/u/click?_t=ac87bfcb4c684a5e8a1b1cac873a41e1&_m=f6d8dea6bfab4d579f18305767afa8a5&_e=lU2xIRta9Jgj1Nzt2c9a7q53wSHDLZv66lV0D6VFbKUD2ucVPQ_OzZ466EfVUdFpV7pASDXnQ8qrOP_t4o633qdhu9idCDje0cQPSTuNinldkm4AZngVp8QC1oVyTY5jMl3__LP1RLaWBbNMYfw6ZLJvEwcTI_qa9FyRWk-24xZcwtzIcz5yW0CWuTFmGx9PybgQdwo7193ZR7FvWkX8AUR6YRFKLHCdh4A1omjNzSKg5k_-F7NU9s437FvX5HL-pgQSIRmn5ogmsj_TJFCEWU3haj0K0PATFVP-yi2fRmOT-MgYOYrekaFZTyldmKfOv9pB2FFiWBsLYuiQpwvEQQ%3D%3D) .

** Biden Border Crisis
------------------------------------------------------------
Illegal immigrants are flooding the southern border every single day, with over 11,000 in a single day this week alone, according to CBP. You’ve seen the media coverage, which shows the ease at which these illegal aliens, many working-aged single males, are simply walking across the border with impunity.

It’s heartbreaking to see an American president, one who was elected to protect the people, have so little interest in the effects this massive influx of illegals is having at home. Worse, not only is the Biden Administration failing to adequately defend and secure the border, but they are fueling the crisis.

It is an embarrassment on the world stage — but more, it’s a dereliction of duty.

It must be noted that the border crisis is not a partisan issue, as every town is now a border town.

In fact, it has gotten so bad that even leaders of the country’s most liberal cities, including New York City Mayor Eric Adams, are calling for immediate action. The city is seeing over 10,000 migrants a month.

“Everyone will be impacted by this,” said Mayor Adams. “The city we knew — we’re about to lose.”

** DEI on College Campuses
------------------------------------------------------------
There is no question that American universities lean heavily towards the left and sadly, conservative students, along with many professors, have been almost entirely silenced in fear of being canceled, failed, and ostracized on campus and in the classroom. DEI — Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion — figures and programs are unfortunately very prevalent on college campuses, fervently trying to influence students to become warriors of extreme liberal ideologies after graduation. College is no longer a place for healthy debate, growth, or opinion. The left is taking advantage of these young, impressionable minds that are living in the last few of their formative years.

A frightening yet hopeful read by Jonathan Pidluzny, PH.D. last week dives into what it means to have these radical beliefs instilled in the classroom, the damage that’s been done so far, and what legislation has been proposed to rid universities of this incessant rot and decay.

** Welcome to the team, Congressman Doug Collins!
------------------------------------------------------------
This year, we took the America First Agenda across the Nation, achieving over 400 legislative wins in 21 states. To further advance our work in the states, we launched the first-of-its-kind America First Governors’ Council, and we will soon begin the first phase of our nationwide expansion with the launch of state chapters in California, Florida, Arizona, Pennsylvania, and Georgia.

As such, we recently brought on former Congressman Doug Collins to Chair our Georgia state chapter. In addition to serving in the Georgia state house and in Congress, U.S. Air Force Reserve chaplain, Doug has ministered to our country's military since 2002.

We are blessed to have the best of the best at AFPI, and we are so grateful for Doug being willing to lean in once more for Georgia and for America.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

| | Dear Friends and Neighbors:

What kind of person do you want in Congress? You have options.
* A great telemarketer? Some politicians spend hours a day calling wealthy donors.
* A social media sensation? That’s how John Fetterman became a senator, isn’t it?
* A master manipulator? Lots of politicians are experts at fooling the public.

The professional political class values all these things in a candidate, plus fame, fortune, and incumbency. And it’s not just the Democrats - the GOP establishment pushes these skills and traits too.

What’s missing is leadership, plain and simple. And that’s what our country needs.

My whole candidacy is staked on the premise that local voters want an authentic leader with real-world experience and courage to take a stand. Here is what I offer:
* 28 years defending our nation in uniform at home and abroad
* 18 years owning a technology infrastructure and cybersecurity company
* 24 years of marriage to Susan and dad to Will, Jake, and Eli

When I talk about Safe Communities, Good Jobs, and Strong Families, I’m not reciting talking points or developing a narrative. I’m explaining my qualifications. I’ve been advancing these ideals successfully for almost 30 years.

And I’m not doing this to find a job, advance my career, or get a raise. Politics isn’t my livelihood. I’m doing this to serve my country and help my community.

If that’s the kind of person you want in Congress, please help me get there.

[Volunteer](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=93d7c3da1d&e=1090c5c412). [Donate](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=ea52e59032&e=1090c5c412). Tell your neighbors.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 40 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life.

Neither military information nor photos of Kevin or Will in uniform imply endorsement of Kevin Dellicker for Congress by the Dept. of Defense or its particular military departments._

Friend,
Former Speaker John Boehner referred to Rep. Jim Jordan as a "political terrorist," saying, "I just never saw a guy who spent more time tearing things apart — never building anything, never putting anything together."
Today, my opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman, said he will vote for Jim Jordan for Speaker because "we need to pass critical legislation." One problem; he's never passed a bill in his life.
Bergman is supporting Jordan because they both:
• Claim the 2020 Presidential election was stolen.
• Want to cut Social Security and Medicare.
• Participated in events that caused Jan. 6.
• Protect billionaires from paying the taxes.
Shame on Rep. Bergman for supporting more division and discord. We need change, and with your help, we absolutely can (and must) defeat someone willing to shut down the government if they don't get their way.
Americans are over it. We're over partisan politics and need uniters in every district across the US. A representative's role is to represent the people of their district, not radical fringe party interests.
Jim Jordan will cause more chaos and inaction, which is exactly what we don't need in Congress. Help me defeat Jordan's sycophant, Jack Bergman. Together, united, we can do this!
Thank you,
-Bob

With climate chaos threatening our lives, health, jobs, and future; and microplastics being found in every corner of our planet, addressing environmental issues and climate change are some of my priorities as your US Senator. I hope you’ll [join me](https://click.everyaction.com/k/71728553/433055464/636880288?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVhMDdmYzEyLTE1NmQtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1Y6Ks-Qkpee1O-VDy0PGsohoL9icjmsezz4YvrpsFc8=&emci=c6204575-136d-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=5a07fc12-156d-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) for a virtual town hall hosted by OLCV. **OLCV Virtual Town Hall on the Environment with Senator Jeff Merkley**
**WHEN:** October 26, 2023 from 12pm to 1:15pm
**WHERE:** Zoom - **[RSVP here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/71728554/433055465/636880288?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVhMDdmYzEyLTE1NmQtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1Y6Ks-Qkpee1O-VDy0PGsohoL9icjmsezz4YvrpsFc8=&emci=c6204575-136d-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=5a07fc12-156d-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230)** At the virtual town hall hosted by OLCV, I’m looking forward to talking to you about what we’ve been working on in the capital to do just that–from protecting public lands to my recent legislation supporting pollinator populations that are near solar projects. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d6955437b62c4c53a5f97aeefebbeed0&_e=ffHS4J5YmlaPo9tjClpW5FHMbD4rn2jF6VCgGjXdIwIO5YfoNI1fMs01-yh1sUs8_3NBBswScv84q9C7_hvlgTR1dzGQUEYUoGMfCm_Omw0Z7FQabWhmXZPuPkINnRG2OeD-9BU8w8PX_NhhfmBAIhSNizjprTQ7zRw2cpINpSxtoibIlES6hXA8NMEjgtBuiZX-2behgoN4rSVPrwpF05J0cNet7t5wr6kSTDMQTdnJSF3aWbfaCw0pPMROddVeFpE-Yn-n0qCyyiBED-UnAA7bsOsdaItpotp6Nzog8CEUIJuDtQrJbhGHBvpA-QESekTCZ0Rs4iR8FNPU7B4ubdDzhSqJ-c-SD9fB6G1ckxOgjT2WSgRUMSamdAMJxNilXqGstiAfgUD9gruQF_BpZQ%3D%3D)**

subject: Can we really afford two wars?
body:
It’s time to dismantle the empire.

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=psQUkJGc26u6Wi0imicX-00jZnUVaZYVu06OFU-xtOc&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231016all_yellenquote&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen was asked if the U.S. can afford another war in this economy. She replied that America can “certainly afford” it. Really? How do you explain to the millions of Americans struggling to get by that we have money for not one, but two wars? We all know the truth: The war machine is draining resources that should go to solving our problems at home. More than 34 million in the U.S. struggle with food insecurity. Homelessness is at record highs. Child poverty is soaring. But instead of implementing policies to lift up poor and working class people living at the margins, Joe Biden is seeking Congressional funding from a dysfunctional legislative branch to fuel war machines in both Ukraine and Israel. **We need new and principled leadership that will challenge organized greed like everyone’s life depends on it, because it does. Your support helps make this campaign for truth, justice, and love stronger.[Can you help us show the war-hungry duopoly that we do not support destructive wars by clicking here?](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231016all_yellenquote&n=2)**

We can no longer tolerate politicians who willingly burn money to fuel a war machine while so many people lack the basic necessities of life here in America. Dr. Cornel West is running to end the militaristic grip of the derelict duopoly and to end senseless and brutal wars. Thank you for standing with us.

Solidarity, **Team Cornel West 2024**

name: Dr. Shawn Wilson
subject: The honor of a lifetime
body:
wilsonforla.com [wilsonforla.com]
Peter,
My campaign for Louisiana Governor began in earnest on March 6 - seven months and 10 days ago. It was to be a sprint, not a marathon, I saw a void and had the fortitude to fill it . The willingness to lead began long before that, perhaps as far back as when I announced to my mom, Sandra, that I was running for student council at my elementary school. Immediately, my family stood with me as they have till this day .
Thank you to everyone who believed in me and what this campaign stood for. Thank you for your time, treasure, and vote - I am eternally grateful.
I have always been willing to serve . For me, it’s never been about power or attention, it’s always been about improving Louisiana , working wherever and with whomever was interested in getting things done for people that needed more. When I said my ministry was public service, which started 25 years ago, I meant that. And my ministry didn't stop when I retired from the State of Louisiana . It will not stop now.
https://youtu.be/zsRIa04dBjs?si=rkX4bZDpxf2eXc8x [https://youtu.be/zsRIa04dBjs?si=rkX4bZDpxf2eXc8x]
Running for Louisiana Governor has been the honor of a lifetime, a capstone to more than two decades of transparent and ethical public service . Throughout this campaign, we’ve crisscrossed the state, traversing many roads and projects the Department of Transportation and Development started, completed, or secured funding for under my watch. We exceeded 60,000 miles driven , with the wear and tear on the vehicles completely worth it as we brought my vision for Louisiana to the people directly. We also raised nearly $3 million from a coordinated effort from over 6,000 donors in our grassroots effort to be elected Governor, which would have been our state’s first Black Governor in Louisiana since reconstruction.
While we did not earn the victory we hoped for, there are no regrets in the Wilson household . The difference one makes is not always in the outcome that one would have - we made a difference in this race and the State of Louisiana .
I'm confident that we put it all on the table; countless calls, texts, emails, and meetings, to ensure we elected the most qualified candidate and secure Louisiana's future. Through it all, we persisted, fought, and gave this race our absolute all. That is what Louisiana is built on – we are a resilient people.
There are absolutely no regrets because we know we made a difference for the right reasons ; that difference reverberates through neighborhoods and families across this entire state. They will remember our campaign forever, and it's my hope and prayer that the next campaign can stand on our shoulders and the impact we have made. This is how this campaign's legacy continues to live on.
Let's use this as a rallying call to hold our government accountable – let's make sure our Governor, our legislators, and our local officials show up to do what we expect them to do. While we may not understand everything Jeff Landry wants to do as Governor, I pray he wants to try to do the right thing.
Let’s also work at every level to better organize and mobilize to advance democratic principles. You don’t have to be elected to do that, you just have to care, want to make a difference, and be willing to put in the work. For Louisianans of various party affiliations, we can’t be better, until we do better!
Don't give up on Louisiana , don't give up on this great state, because we've got a lot more ahead of us,and if there’s one thing Louisianans are known for, it is strength in the face of hardships. Let’s have faith and keep up our spirits.
With hope for Louisiana,
Dr. Shawn Wilson

Derek, my journey to Congress looks a bit different than most.

**My mom was my biggest hero growing up.** She raised me on her own in Dallas, and I spent most afternoons at the local YMCA while she worked a second job to make ends meet. With a lot of hard work and support from my mom, coaches, and teachers, I earned a full football scholarship to Baylor and went on to play in the NFL.
Then, I went to law school, became a civil rights attorney to protect voting rights, and served in the Obama administration.

I ran for Congress because I don’t want my story to be the exception – **I want all kids to have every opportunity to achieve their dreams.**
**Now, I’m running for Senate because I’m sick and tired of watching Ted Cruz fail Texas kids and families. And experts agree we can win – since launching our campaign, both Roll Call and the Cook Political Report have increased our chances.**
**But it’s going to take the biggest grassroots movement Texas has ever seen, and I need you to be a part of it, Derek. body:
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20231017-1?refcode=em20231017-1-8624&refcode2=8624_434096_iyxAe1&akid=8624%2E434096%2EiyxAe1)
Derek,
I'm stressed. My finance team just called me to let me know we're still $23,736 short of our October fundraising goal -- **this is especially bad news because national Republican groups are attacking me earlier than ever before.**
**[Before I explain any more, I wanted to ask: Is there any way you can split a contribution between John Fetterman and my campaign to help us reach our mid-month fundraising goal today? It's important.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20231017-1?refcode=em20231017-1-8624&refcode2=8624_434096_iyxAe1&akid=8624%2E434096%2EiyxAe1)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20231017-1?amount=5&refcode=em20231017-8624&refcode2=8624_434096_iyxAe1&akid=8624%2E434096%2EiyxAe1)**
We're in this race for the long haul. But it's going to be tough.
With all the chaos in Washington (especially now), Montanans deserve someone who will crack down on the special interests and corruption in Washington, not play political games and cut backroom deals. We need to fight to lower costs for hardworking families, create good-paying union jobs, and ensure rural communities have what they need, like reliable internet and hospitals within driving distance.
Derek, I'm not a career politician. I'm pretty different from most people who end up in the U.S. Senate. **I still farm the same land my grandparents homesteaded 100 years ago, and I try every day to do what's right for the people of Montana and across the country.**
Because of that, I don't have much patience for the fancy billionaires and shady super PACs a lot of other politicians rely on. Instead, I depend on grassroots supporters like you.
That's why I'm so grateful you even opened this email. Emails like this one make up a big part of our budget. $5 here and $10 there goes a long way in a campaign like ours.
**So, here's the part where I ask:[Can you make a split contribution of $17.77 (our average online donation) today to John Fetterman and my campaign meet our mid-month goal? Your donations keep me fighting for regular folks in Washington, and will help us respond to the onslaught of out-of-state money coming in to attack my record.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20231017-1?refcode=em20231017-1-8624&refcode2=8624_434096_iyxAe1&akid=8624%2E434096%2EiyxAe1)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20231017-1?amount=5&refcode=em20231017-8624&refcode2=8624_434096_iyxAe1&akid=8624%2E434096%2EiyxAe1)**
We're close to the finish line, and your support right now really helps me out.
-- Jon
Jon Tester
U.S. Senator from Montana

clean_body: Derek, I'm stressed. My finance team just called me to let me know we're still $23,736 short of our October fundraising goal -- this is especially bad news because national Republican groups are attacking me earlier than ever before. We're in this race for the long haul. But it's going to be tough. With all the chaos in Washington (especially now), Montanans deserve someone who will crack down on the special interests and corruption in Washington, not play political games and cut backroom deals. We need to fight to lower costs for hardworking families, create good-paying union jobs, and ensure rural communities have what they need, like reliable internet and hospitals within driving distance. Derek, I'm not a career politician. I'm pretty different from most people who end up in the U.S. Senate. I still farm the same land my grandparents homesteaded 100 years ago, and I try every day to do what's right for the people of Montana and across the country. Because of that, I don't have much patience for the fancy billionaires and shady super PACs a lot of other politicians rely on. Instead, I depend on grassroots supporters like you. That's why I'm so grateful you even opened this email. Emails like this one make up a big part of our budget. $5 here and $10 there goes a long way in a campaign like ours. So, here's the part where I ask: We're close to the finish line, and your support right now really helps me out. -- Jon Jon Tester U.S. Senator from Montana | | Email us: info@johnfetterman.com

We just got some breaking news, folks:
A multimillionaire Republican celebrity just jumped into our top-two “jungle primary” in the U.S. Senate race.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/74758/images/garvey.jpg]

Steve Garvey was a first baseman for the Dodgers and Padres, and apparently he’s ready to take up the fight for everyone born on third base thinking they hit a triple. Go figure.

Thanks for your support,
Adam

_**After 20 successful years, HSAs in need of modernization**_ By Bobby Jindal & Newt Gingrich _Even with the successes, it is time to update and modernize Health Savings Accounts_
---
Twenty years ago this December, President George W. Bush signed the bipartisan Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement and Modernization Act of 2003. In addition to creating the Medicare Part D prescription drug benefit, the bill created the Health Savings Account (HSA). Health Savings Accounts are sometimes criticized as being a tool for the wealthy, but in fact, 78% of the over 31 million Americans with an HSA have a household income of less than $100,000. That’s because the HSA is the most powerful retirement savings vehicle for the middle class ever created – even better than a 401K. Not only can the funds in the account be invested in stocks, bonds and funds, but they can also be withdrawn without penalty so long as they are spent on a qualified medical expense. This makes HSAs unique in that both the contributions and disbursements are tax free. **[FINISH READING ON FOXNEWS.COM](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=4e6c6ad0637b40bbbd9692708068b75d&_e=fxnOR-1oXu8PHReobf5rH_1Loip1dG1JVb4oDYYYzjtc-M87wIrbOLi7esCH70n3NVGTq8_fiTkBkecykFgfBBNAeG_07MKhIolfl8zJAGSQQW_8M8eE8zVP59mYDNdxWm3XwdmB_uBZ5KUh6hxRfCwqJxcpRxQUKmyvQqoDaK4rAm8mNQejveOUFsEX8qDCb8s3Sq9eH064uc6pcd9CIYWdeNtstMHZpnKn60wf_BcOIR47el1vlhcxPuh_GFCjWPCKjqHhFUL9C7cn5dcN1g%3D%3D)**

body:
In just two years, the far-right outlet has grown its revenue by 685%.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71735414/433080964/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTE0NDNiZGMtMjc2ZC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZgL7zbrmA4apxkmCBvAhBDHRMTYG8bSv2nMsDrR5iVc=&emci=0a9d8068-f86c-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=e1443bdc-276d-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
In the lead-up to the 2020 election, The Epoch Times was unknown to most. But after spending millions of dollars in advertising supporting Donald Trump and echoing the ‘Big Lie’, the far-right’s latest propaganda outlet’s audience and profits have grown at an alarming rate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71735431/433080966/-932789538?refcode=em20231017&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTE0NDNiZGMtMjc2ZC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZgL7zbrmA4apxkmCBvAhBDHRMTYG8bSv2nMsDrR5iVc=)
Some social media platforms such as Facebook banned the group from advertising, while others such as YouTube have not. As a result, the once-fringe organization has now entered the mainstream.
**This is _dangerous_ , Peter.** The rise of the Epoch Times and other recent right-wing networks such as Newsmax and OAN have contributed to America’s growing information crisis _and_ threaten the future of our democracy.
We’ll explain more about the rise of the Epoch Times in a moment but if you’re short on time but still want to make a difference in Courier’s fight against right-wing misinformation, **[can you chip in whatever you can today to support our honest journalism?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71735432/433080997/-932789538?refcode=em20231017&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTE0NDNiZGMtMjc2ZC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZgL7zbrmA4apxkmCBvAhBDHRMTYG8bSv2nMsDrR5iVc=)**
Despite attempts to disguise itself as a legitimate news organization, its far-right slant can be **clearly** seen in recent reports such as, “Jan 6. Capitol Hill Security Footage Challenges Key Narratives” and “Meteorologists, Scientists Explain Why There is ‘No Climate Emergency.’”
**We're not fooled by their BS, Peter. If you're sick and tired of the right-wing media's constant attacks on the truth and our democracy and you're ready to hold them accountable, then keep reading.**
We founded Courier Newsroom to be the good information antidote to the bad information that’s pushed by outlets like Fox News and The Epoch Times.
Unlike Epoch and the far-right media, we will never compromise our values for a quick buck. We will always call out right-wing misinformation and tell the _whole_ truth. Our model restores trust in journalism by covering local stories that matter most to the communities we serve.
**AND we deliver those vital stories to the online spaces where people actually spend their time.**
If we’re going to keep exposing disinformation from right-wing propaganda outlets like The Epoch Times, it’s _imperative_ that we have the resources we need to expand our network of nine newsrooms and hire talented journalists to correct the record and cover the stories that actually impact people’s lives. **[Will you pitch in anything you can today to support Courier's accessible, fact-based reporting?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71735447/433080999/-932789538?refcode=em20231017&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTE0NDNiZGMtMjc2ZC1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZgL7zbrmA4apxkmCBvAhBDHRMTYG8bSv2nMsDrR5iVc=)**

body:
I’m the frontman for a Jimi Hendrix tribute band that plays in some of Connecticut’s most rockin’ venues... but that’s not all!

| |
---
| | |
Peter - Have you heard the news?

**[I'm running for Congress in the most important battleground race in the entire country.](http://links.goppatriot.com/u/click?_t=42a94c663c6c423587715e465a367b7d&_m=cd3a7b452971492b8aed7adedeaab42a&_e=V9JEycp0wk3A5ppZV-ENjygX5ldgl2fSo3oZV67jWzVjt1HKlOEofq7sFQlXyA4KOVxKoXbPD63uc21G3nk0a8QX_OsRLBuvRBT3bmX2KZFm6sEJFPdGvIE0SGpyAtCPETrNfsT9vBTX6fPNHx2vclnompiYwTfJd3X7T2uGuxPrdJDGe0iQzvyDzX9sCTpB0b37aNJooxM1cRJGNY3s67ee36JrMV-kCoePpi4xNGhlYOtuRZXzbi4AeZiRmO_gwWfPJoNBGQb81G1ZPu5VBOM1SUu1ckHYpDINwFH3V3-wW2PJEB_KrYRHEUI1rh9del8xXCRSWcYSqvTMWwEC3zIWhWc4e5tB8ht6lO96V_E3NEaVV6eqrGiUAm83jxjI "I’m running for Congress in the most important battleground race in the entire country.")**

**My name is George Logan.** I'm a proud family man, engineer, community leader, small business owner, and frontman for Electric Lady Band, a Jimi Hendrix tribute band that plays in some of Connecticut's most rockin' venues.
---
| | [](http://links.goppatriot.com/u/click?_t=42a94c663c6c423587715e465a367b7d&_m=cd3a7b452971492b8aed7adedeaab42a&_e=V9JEycp0wk3A5ppZV-ENjygX5ldgl2fSo3oZV67jWzVjt1HKlOEofq7sFQlXyA4KOVxKoXbPD63uc21G3nk0a8QX_OsRLBuvRBT3bmX2KZFm6sEJFPdGvIE0SGpyAtCPETrNfsT9vBTX6fPNHx2vclnompiYwTfJd3X7T2uGuxPrdJDGe0iQzvyDzX9sCTpB0b37aNJooxM1cRJGNY3s67ee36JrMV-kCoePpi4xNGg2CyWSw4OINiYB-Clxng4yqe3xukWJrfGwpM3XkQgDMq1esDqNVkdkzNAXm9yx1k5VxzFt6dY7_MzB352cJzAqISTuD8nZfbeTj200VdL7euBahFxxQM5dpZw9D60PQqrJS2G1jcasFNAw-IrlhvPJ)

Although, it's more likely you know me from my 2022 campaign for Congress, where **we narrowly missed flipping Connecticut's 5th Congressional District red by fewer than 2,000 votes.**

When handed a tough defeat, you have two choices - you can give up, or you can regroup and come back stronger than before.

But if we are going to be successful in this rematch, then I'm going to need your help right now! **Last time, we were outraised by over $1,000,000,** **[so I need your help to make sure our campaign starts strong and closes the gap!](http://links.goppatriot.com/u/click?_t=42a94c663c6c423587715e465a367b7d&_m=cd3a7b452971492b8aed7adedeaab42a&_e=V9JEycp0wk3A5ppZV-ENjygX5ldgl2fSo3oZV67jWzVjt1HKlOEofq7sFQlXyA4KOVxKoXbPD63uc21G3nk0a8QX_OsRLBuvRBT3bmX2KZFm6sEJFPdGvIE0SGpyAtCPETrNfsT9vBTX6fPNHx2vclnompiYwTfJd3X7T2uGuxPrdJDGe0iQzvyDzX9sCTpB0b37aNJooxM1cRJGNY3s67ee36JrMV-kCoePpi4xNGgCjPTSmM237G2l9YEKlgPrujHzbFvF3Pj0VA07rEj9F0Qgt6EaRnnqM1pa2eAO1j1c__DZOvuFXN7B8RneRNpS684wgU9sQEMo2S0_L3r0tlT1m0aKUku_gJQGiYcoEEVdF1HrC6wdMSMp3fB2kcRA "so I need your help to make sure our campaign starts strong and closes the gap!")**

Look, I'm the son of immigrants. My grandparents left Jamaica for Guatemala during the Great Depression, and like so many other American families, my parents left Guatemala and came to America to grow a family and build a better life. **I 've seen that it takes hard work to overcome challenges.**
| | [](http://links.goppatriot.com/u/click?_t=42a94c663c6c423587715e465a367b7d&_m=cd3a7b452971492b8aed7adedeaab42a&_e=V9JEycp0wk3A5ppZV-ENjygX5ldgl2fSo3oZV67jWzVjt1HKlOEofq7sFQlXyA4KOVxKoXbPD63uc21G3nk0a8QX_OsRLBuvRBT3bmX2KZFm6sEJFPdGvIE0SGpyAtCPETrNfsT9vBTX6fPNHx2vclnompiYwTfJd3X7T2uGuxPrdJDGe0iQzvyDzX9sCTpB0b37aNJooxM1cRJGNY3s67ee36JrMV-kCoePpi4xNGhpJ4bOL6Q5GD1U9Z45YZLAIgefuD1QOt8gc9FqOGyHFyby2ZR9IFExyTSsR7mW9OLSkTEEExf8M50EwJiP71HS33-T27PbF0OuN5Fe6-vZqZsVqiUhqdUXNr_wMZmljNsQl2MTQ7bXguH3LBIyT2Yv)
---
This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the values I live by today: to **put your family first, give back to your community, value your education, and always work hard.**

They worked day and night at factory jobs and office administrative work to ensure I was getting the education to land a better job **so that I could pursue my American dream. **
---
| | [](http://links.goppatriot.com/u/click?_t=42a94c663c6c423587715e465a367b7d&_m=cd3a7b452971492b8aed7adedeaab42a&_e=V9JEycp0wk3A5ppZV-ENjygX5ldgl2fSo3oZV67jWzVjt1HKlOEofq7sFQlXyA4KOVxKoXbPD63uc21G3nk0a8QX_OsRLBuvRBT3bmX2KZFm6sEJFPdGvIE0SGpyAtCPETrNfsT9vBTX6fPNHx2vclnompiYwTfJd3X7T2uGuxPrdJDGe0iQzvyDzX9sCTpB0b37aNJooxM1cRJGNY3s67ee36JrMV-kCoePpi4xNGiqqoTwmoOofwfctWKOx8RoE3Pa4p5BBtndTIm75z7RPmQcLzGLsLQQjjPkeQy39xNB2jxWtlXepGoh0pI46tX8EtPrZ6eNfJS185a4-fDED_STdlYO3vzAltVjlzsuMuQGdEolnbVqDVEIZ3xRhe4J)
---
I am a first-generation college graduate, and I even earned my master's degree. I had to take out a good amount of student loans, but as my parents taught me, my hard work would pay off.

I soon met my wife, Lisa, and we fell in love. She has always been my rock. She spent her career working as a nurse, helping those struggling with their mental health and addiction.**Together we did what every family strives to do, make sure the American Dream lives on for our children.**
---
| [](http://links.goppatriot.com/u/click?_t=42a94c663c6c423587715e465a367b7d&_m=cd3a7b452971492b8aed7adedeaab42a&_e=V9JEycp0wk3A5ppZV-ENjygX5ldgl2fSo3oZV67jWzVjt1HKlOEofq7sFQlXyA4KOVxKoXbPD63uc21G3nk0a8QX_OsRLBuvRBT3bmX2KZFm6sEJFPdGvIE0SGpyAtCPETrNfsT9vBTX6fPNHx2vclnompiYwTfJd3X7T2uGuxPrdJDGe0iQzvyDzX9sCTpB0b37aNJooxM1cRJGNY3s67ee36JrMV-kCoePpi4xNGgdK_Y_dbqp6wqgrdUUQYwqAHubCtxNnXgRu1PlqSxxJBKo1zLs9kLrm_097gmjR2FbjXT6jjRYFRPTSqyXGwF9OFHnRdzBhIdQaLQPcO9Hx1UxU7km51OLHDUjCUv-IN26dXgQfL-nryVox9xpCBYg)

Lisa and I could not be prouder of our kids. But my goal is to continue making them proud of me; **my job as their role model is not done yet.**

I am living proof that the American dream is alive and well, but that dream cannot end with me. I want my children and future generations to have the opportunity to reach their full potential in life.

I have seen the mess that Joe Biden and the Democrats' policies have brought upon our nation, and I have seen firsthand the struggles it has placed on my community. **I can 't stand the fact that this is the environment our children have to start their lives in**.

Our country has lost sight of our founding principles due to poor leadership and a culture that looks down on patriotism, and **[I'm ready to do something about it.](http://links.goppatriot.com/u/click?_t=42a94c663c6c423587715e465a367b7d&_m=cd3a7b452971492b8aed7adedeaab42a&_e=V9JEycp0wk3A5ppZV-ENjygX5ldgl2fSo3oZV67jWzVjt1HKlOEofq7sFQlXyA4KOVxKoXbPD63uc21G3nk0a8QX_OsRLBuvRBT3bmX2KZFm6sEJFPdGvIE0SGpyAtCPETrNfsT9vBTX6fPNHx2vclnompiYwTfJd3X7T2uGuxPrdJDGe0iQzvyDzX9sCTpB0b37aNJooxM1cRJGNY3s67ee36JrMV-kCoePpi4xNGgHIhdpdqsM5yPyzLNA_87LvAY4GSZpVvwcT2JeUWkJQusxtAPats0aJOA_TS-sISAV5Ka9kykLvhkuBuXB7KmciIttAX_nXYKomLYout8yKUw1zHxGYXEGgNLIyUBCmd8jotYrpPSoCbGstZPSxEa- "I’m ready to do something about it.")**

Looking at these photos brought back some great memories, and I hope to keep making more in a country that we all can be proud of.

I know times are hard in Biden's economy, but if you are in the position to give, **[please consider chipping in just $5, $10, or even $25 to help our campaign start strong!](http://links.goppatriot.com/u/click?_t=42a94c663c6c423587715e465a367b7d&_m=cd3a7b452971492b8aed7adedeaab42a&_e=V9JEycp0wk3A5ppZV-ENjygX5ldgl2fSo3oZV67jWzVjt1HKlOEofq7sFQlXyA4KOVxKoXbPD63uc21G3nk0a8QX_OsRLBuvRBT3bmX2KZFm6sEJFPdGvIE0SGpyAtCPETrNfsT9vBTX6fPNHx2vclnompiYwTfJd3X7T2uGuxPrdJDGe0iQzvyDzX9sCTpB0b37aNJooxM1cRJGNY3s67ee36JrMV-kCoePpi4xNGhrkhsm9WVFrkZPqKK1FyXjJo-yqu6W0ZWYWDbA5xsrq8qCQJidceAIm-5LmBrcQhlxeERdoC1ffBnqpdiZnPg_QL-gR7R_KriKzFcTryjmsUCYMlLTCIvRMMz5RwpguoUZMfadnoKXdk-DPTc7qdaK "please consider chipping in just $5, $10, or even $25 to help our campaign start strong!")**

ICYMI: CA47 “Scott Baugh Bankrolled By Right-Wing Advocate For Biblical Law”
Howard F. Ahmanson Jr. Has Bankrolled Scott Baugh “Throughout His Career”

IRVINE, CA —Today, following the American Independent (https://americanindependent.com/scott-baugh-howard-ahmanson-california-lgbtq-rights/) article exposing CA47 MAGA Republican Congressional candidate Republican Scott Baugh’s, longstanding ties to Howard F. Ahmanson Jr., a far-right megadonor who advocates for the imposition of 'biblical law,' and has bankrolled multiple campaigns for Baugh, State Senator Dave Min issued the following statement emphasizing the dangers of electing someone associated with such extreme ideologies.

"Scott Baugh has repeatedly demonstrated that he is too radical to represent Orange County. Any candidate who stands out there pushing for fringe agendas does not deserve to represent the people of Orange County. The fact that Scott Baugh is so closely aligned with a conservative billionaire who openly advocates for the imposition of ‘strict Biblical law’ is not just concerning, it's a glaring reflection of his values and a stark warning of the MAGA extremism he intends to bring to Congress," said State Senator Dave Min.

The article breaks on the heels of news stories (https://www.huffpost.com/entry/scott-baugh-wokism-threat-california-gop-congress-candidate_n_64f25ae2e4b04f9a01e8e2f1#:~:text=California%20Republican%20Scott%20Baugh%3A%20%27Wokism,for%20his%20congressional%20campaign%20said.&text=Scott%20Baugh%20is%20hoping%20to,House%20seat%20in%20Southern%20California.) covering Scott Baugh’s un-patriotic and extreme remarks to the International Christian Ambassadors Association, that “wokism” is more dangerous to the United States than 9/11.

A recent article in American Independent (https://americanindependent.com/scott-baugh-howard-ahmanson-california-lgbtq-rights/) reported on Scott Baugh’s ties to Howard F. Ahmanson Jr., a right-wing mega donor and longtime advocate for strict biblical law, who has been a top donor throughout Baugh’s political career. The story follows recent reporting by HuffPost (https://www.huffpost.com/entry/scott-baugh-wokism-threat-california-gop-congress-candidate_n_64f25ae2e4b04f9a01e8e2f1#:~:text=California%20Republican%20Scott%20Baugh%3A%20%27Wokism,for%20his%20congressional%20campaign%20said.&text=Scott%20Baugh%20is%20hoping%20to,House%20seat%20in%20Southern%20California.) in which Scott Baugh was quoted as saying that “wokism” is more dangerous to California and the United States than 9/11 and previous world wars.

To Read The Full Article Click HERE (https://americanindependent.com/scott-baugh-howard-ahmanson-california-lgbtq-rights/)

>From the American Independent:

“Over the years, Ahmanson Jr. has used his funds to support conservative politicians and Christian organizations. He was a top donor to the group behind California’s unconstitutional Proposition 8, a 2008 ballot initiative that took away the right of same-sex couples to marry, and backed CareNet, which operates anti-abortion crisis pregnancy centers infamous for misleading patients about the procedure.

“Ahmanson spent decades donating to and serving on the board of the Chalcedon Foundation, a tax-exempt organization founded by the late Rousas John Rushdoony that asserts “all things are to be ‘reconstructed’ according to God’s revealed will in Scripture.” Rushdoony urged laws based on “faith, not reason,”
including death by stoning for gay and lesbian people and others as laid out in the Book of Leviticus.”

###

California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15%. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country.

"Loomer Unleashed" is a LIVE news and political commentary show hosted by investigative journalist Laura Loomer. Loomer Unleashed will be streamed exclusively on Rumble every Tuesday and Thursday at 7pm EST, beginning October 17, 2023.
* **Rumble CEO Chris Pavlovski said he is "super excited to add this show to our exclusive lineup."**

Investigative journalist and America First activist Laura Loomer will unleash her uncensored commentary on Rumble and Locals in a new show, "Loomer Unleashed." Starting Tuesday, October 17, 2023, Loomer will host live streams exclusively on Rumble on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 7-9 p.m. EST.
Broadcasting from a new studio, Laura Loomer will cover special reports, break original investigative news stories, and will share her political analysis of the top stories of the week with her sharp commentary and unique brand of guerrilla journalism you won't find anywhere else. More than just a monologue, "Loomer Unleashed" will also feature viewer call-ins, a live chat, and interviews with special guests.
Rumble, a free speech video platform and major competitor to YouTube, released the following statement about Laura Loomer exclusively streaming her show on Rumble.
> **" Being bold and authentic is part of Rumble's DNA, and we feel that this new show, 'Loomer Unleashed,' fits in perfectly," Rumble CEO Chris Pavlovski said in a statement. "We are super excited to add this show to our exclusive lineup."**
In addition to the new show on Rumble, Laura Loomer's investigative journalism is moving to Locals. Written news stories and other exclusive content will be now also available to paid subscribers on Locals who want the full "Loomer Unleashed" experience.
**About Laura Loomer**
Laura Loomer is a conservative political activist, investigative journalist, author, and former America First Congressional candidate in Florida. Her controversial, outspoken views have earned her the status as "The Most Banned Woman In The World", as she has been banned from social media sites, payment processors, and even food delivery services, which she chronicled in her 2021 book "_[Loomered: How I Became the Most Banned Woman in the World." ](https://substack.com/redirect/504e2ce0-c86f-4d19-8ab5-d835ea8ec88c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_Before launching her own media company, Illoominate Media, LLC, Laura previously worked for work Project Veritas, InfoWars, and Rebel News.

There aren't many governor's races in 2023, but there is one just a few weeks away in Kentucky.

Friends -
In just a moment I am going to ask you to make a contribution to Kentucky's Democratic Governor, Andy Beshear. Please let me explain why this request, especially today, is so important.
There aren't many governor's races in 2023, but there is one just a few weeks away in Kentucky.
Republicans nominated a Trump devotee, Daniel Cameron, as their candidate. In his victory speech he said, "The Trump culture of winning is alive and well in Kentucky."
He has the support of Trump, and the entire MAGA-right. And as you read this he and his allies are spending tons of money to flip this seat.
But Democratic Governor Andy Beshear is one of the most popular governors in America — even in a red state. He is the only Democratic incumbent governor up for re-election this year and he needs our help.
Andy is popular because he had the courage to expand Medicaid and give health care to people in his state who desperately need it.
He is popular because time and time again, he chooses to stand and fight for working people in his state.
He is a shining example of what is possible when Democrats fight for what is right everywhere. And he needs our help. Today.
And because this is Kentucky and not a crazily expensive Senate race or even a statewide race in California our donations will go a very long way — especially with just a few weeks to go.
That's why I am asking:
[**Can you PLEASE rush a $3 contribution directly to Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear's re-election campaign today? | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment. In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular. Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. name: Adam Schiff
subject: My legislation would end gun manufacturers’ legal immunity from civil lawsuits
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
| Manufacturers and dealers reap profits while families suffer from the repeated cycles of gun violence and fear. And yet the gun liability shield prevents victims and their families from having their day in court and holding gun manufacturers accountable — all while Mitch McConnell and Senate Republicans hide behind the filibuster and refuse to act.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4247%2E5257348%2E-dd2uf)
Derek,
For years, I’ve worked to get weapons of war off our streets and put an end to the National Rifle Association’s corrupt, pervasive power over our government. But it’s clear that change must come from within the Senate.
**The outrageous truth is that the multibillion-dollar gun industry enjoys a shield of legal immunity afforded to _no other American industry_ — thanks to a perverse NRA-backed 2005 law called the _Protection of Lawful Commerce in Arms Act (PLCAA)._**
Manufacturers and dealers reap profits while families suffer from the repeated cycles of gun violence and fear. And yet the gun liability shield prevents victims and their families from having their day in court and holding gun manufacturers accountable — all while Mitch McConnell and Senate Republicans hide behind the filibuster and refuse to act.
As California’s next U.S. Senator, I’ll fight to abolish the filibuster so that we can pass the legislation I’ve sponsored, the _Equal Access to Justice for Victims of Gun Violence Act_ , to ensure victims and their families can have their day in court. A bill President Biden is personally championing.
[**If you agree that we need to end legal immunity for gun manufacturers, allow victims and families to pursue justice in civil court, and hold gun manufacturers financially liable for the damages caused by the proliferation of deadly weapons in the wrong hands, add your name as a citizen co-sponsor of my _Equal Access to Justice for Victims of Gun Violence Act_ today.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20231017-gvp-petition/.38c6j1&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20231017_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4247%2E5257348%2E-dd2uf)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20231017-gvp-petition/.KLc8hH&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20231017_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=4247%2E5257348%2E-dd2uf)
---
Gun violence is a daily horror, and what’s more, victims and their families have virtually no legal recourse to hold accountable the manufacturers who market these guns or the sellers which act negligently in their sale.
I’ve not shied away from the fight to keep our families safe from gun violence — and **I’m hugely inspired by the pathbreaking work of the late Senator Dianne Feinstein on gun safety.**
She arrived in the Senate as a powerful advocate for gun safety and succeeded in passing legislation that saved lives, including the 1994 assault weapons ban.
But in the years since George W. Bush and congressional Republicans allowed that ban to expire and passed the NRA’s _PLCAA_ legislation, the frequency and deadliness of mass shootings have increased with no end in sight.
**That’s why we need to forge ahead on the path Senator Feinstein set for us on guns — taking real, serious action to save lives and keep dangerous weapons out of the hands of those who should not have them.**
[**Please, add your name as a citizen co-sponsor of my legislation, the _Equal Access to Justice for Victims of Gun Violence Act._**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20231017-gvp-petition/.38c6j1&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20231017_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=4247%2E5257348%2E-dd2uf)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20231017-gvp-petition/.KLc8hH&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20231017_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=7&akid=4247%2E5257348%2E-dd2uf)
---
No other country suffers from the deadly frequency of mass shootings and broader gun violence that we experience in the United States.
It doesn’t have to be this way. It shouldn’t be this way.
We have the power to change it. Thanks for raising your voice with mine on behalf of all victims of gun violence and their families today.
— Adam

clean_body: Democrats are ready to deliver results, not inaction and chaos. | | | | We talk a lot about 2024's November elections, but this November, there are hundreds of Democrats up and down the ballot that need our support in critical elections across the country. Right now, Virginians are casting ballots in state elections that will decide the balance of power in the General Assembly. Republicans currently control the House and only need to pick up a few seats in the Senate to gain total control of the state legislature. But Governor Glenn Youngkin, a Republican, has already said that he'll use Republican control of the legislature to enact a 15-week abortion ban — a ban that would impact not only Virginians, but also residents in other southern states who come to Virginia for abortion access. Because the stakes are too high to sit on the sidelines, our team is joining forces with Indivisible Oregon to help send out Vote Forward letters ahead of the 2023 Virginia November elections. These personal, handwritten letters are sent to Democratic-leaning voters in Virginia's critical swing seats who need just a little extra nudge to vote before polls close. In addition to protecting access to safe abortion care in the state by electing Democrats this November, engaging voters now helps lay the groundwork for success in 2024. = = Thank you for making a difference across the country. Let's start the Democratic blue wave early by winning big in Virginia on November 7. Onward! Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

| | Praying for Israel...

The attack on Israel has hit close to home for so many, including the American citizens who volunteer in our Republicans Overseas (RO) Israel chapter.
Marc Zell has kept us up to speed on the ground almost daily. His son is a tank commander at the frontlines, first in the line of fire. Abe Katsman's nephew was among the first Americans to be murdered by Hamas.

Did you know that many of those kidnapped and murdered by Hamas at the music festival near the Gaza border were, in fact, staunch Palestine supporters? You don't hear many of those details on the mainstream media.

Last week, RNC’s Committee on Faith Engagement talked with Oregon's RNC National Committeeman, Solomon Yue, and together they arranged a first-person update from RO's Israel office for RNC's 168 members. Marc Zell was able to attend the call, answer questions from the members and help lead the prayer.
Inexplicably, posts telling Oregon's PCPs about the RNC call and including links to these follow-up interviews below were scrubbed from ORP's "Official" PCP page. "News articles and events" were not allowed, I was told, though that page is primarily composed of ... you guessed it ... articles and events. It's a blessing to know that my newsletter reaches more Oregon PCPs than participate on that page, and I encourage you to forward it to anyone you know so that information like this reaches Republicans across the state uncensored.
Why is this important? RNC's next prayer call is coming up soon, and this one will extend beyond the 168 RNC members. The national calls wind up with _thousands_ of callers participating. Look for more info here later.

I really like that RNC's Committee on Faith Engagement holds these calls. I also like that they engage with members of other RNC committees and Republican groups. Keep praying.

Over & out,

_Kerry_

Vivek is a first-generation American. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| [ ](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=8ac200514a9c4ff297be0421393af27c&_e=NmqPQjF7DP0gzDLGHRcqbMCa4gci2it_4IZv9pjKkaem7xXEVvGK7uxlYihQuHGSOWVg7qsNtZcB-2g7sU8iZQ8l72TckldIcicXYp6I59qASBwtG82evSuXkym2tf7EpBdZQMt6yslZuBe-lhix_QJP2jiyRigiCGpiBobrOovL9ABHX8JJzsKy8LvZmCxf02B3MBTMwdorOpRy9RJ0mmTfrlzUI0XiL83fMlReqMUNMX9z2Tlv7NDe73d6HPohQo-0Bce5JkHBOVINtz861QtBat8SzQEosrHLrgM3j9WAD6x6Xi70PgLzgXiGipOZ)
