Hey, I wanted to take a minute and reach out to you to tell my story.

As a contender for one of the most important congressional races in the country -- I think it's important everybody knows exactly where I stand leading into this election.

So -- let's get right to it.

**_Why am I running for Congress?_**
| [**HELP SECURE THE GOP MAJORITY!** ](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=8ac200514a9c4ff297be0421393af27c&_e=NmqPQjF7DP0gzDLGHRcqbMCa4gci2it_4IZv9pjKkaem7xXEVvGK7uxlYihQuHGSOWVg7qsNtZcB-2g7sU8iZQ8l72TckldIcicXYp6I59qASBwtG82evSuXkym2tf7EpBdZQMt6yslZuBe-lhix_dFMHylZ3OjqawJULT4OUtk-BbwYQkgS5Wupl8T8UWhMard-lVmrcNNwRV-cPoxbQwfgMghjObHxHraP4fnJEEhu0mmiUY0rBsGrLItO2bApKRZ_sZY-w9JyMDGL7YbJWNJMol6yGixRT6f0HGcok0-Gzk21EqomeL_WktlC7mAq)
---

Because it's imperative to bring back the strong America we grew up in.

**For over 12 years, I have served as a Judge for the state of Indiana and was the first female Allen Circuit Court Judge.** I took the gravity of my oath seriously, treating every case fairly and refusing to legislate from the bench.

I had a duty to enforce the law as written, but my position gave me a unique perspective to see where the law needs to be changed to improve our community and country. I saw firsthand what change is needed in this nation, and I intend to work every day to bring back the America we grew up in.

**Now, I 'm asking Hoosiers to send me to Congress to restore the American dream.**

**_What 's my Story?_**
My two siblings and I were raised in a home centered around Christ and immersed in the value of hard work.

My father - the hardest worker I have ever met - came from very humble beginnings and worked his own way through college, eventually earning a Ph.D.

My parents raised me to believe in the American dream because our family was living it. Through hard work and dedication, my family prospered. [**Every family living in this great nation deserves the same opportunity.**](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=8ac200514a9c4ff297be0421393af27c&_e=NmqPQjF7DP0gzDLGHRcqbMCa4gci2it_4IZv9pjKkaem7xXEVvGK7uxlYihQuHGSOWVg7qsNtZcB-2g7sU8iZQ8l72TckldIcicXYp6I59qASBwtG82evSuXkym2tf7Ea2f0VjW1fEJ2m8ZX4Z7as5h4V3n7HoSvoqnSdcWJB2EQI6HKGPw_VhDmc8jSAnEIRYQhy8fcqNK3Nk3qn9emgx3yi8ASXGjSG7yvUwCfgmscuQGyxPkCR5WNfdZyxXOU6Q4XnWybDvqfg6vDcC07UxjK4tZTDpYbtTNGolGSFmyrHhKhfdx1oZAU5vMq3ETS)

[**HELP ME BRING BACK THE AMERICAN DREAM!** ](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=8ac200514a9c4ff297be0421393af27c&_e=NmqPQjF7DP0gzDLGHRcqbMCa4gci2it_4IZv9pjKkaem7xXEVvGK7uxlYihQuHGSOWVg7qsNtZcB-2g7sU8iZQ8l72TckldIcicXYp6I59qASBwtG82evSuXkym2tf7EpBdZQMt6yslZuBe-lhix_aFelAaDUqm8WrM1RWCRfgZ2ihPtDnojpWWmNM02rtFucyF4d2_z1UasXIZSr7bErbJtyL-pBetWmbtorgNuPgfcbh1edAKktOcyZgdupX8NN1iAVOxT1bTDCK2xnk06mYyxEltRadd_ie7MueczASdA_1rI8gY9sk2lUUN8TBNx)
---

I was instilled with my father's work ethic and determination. A product of Fort Wayne public schools, I went on to attend Wheaton College in Illinois, where I met my future husband, Scott. I continued my education at Valparaiso University School of Law, completing my J.D. at Saint Mary's Law School in San Antonio, Texas when Scott began his active duty in the U.S. Army.

**As the daughter of a U.S. Army Reservist, the wife of a Lieutenant Colonel in the U.S. Air Force - Indiana Air National Guard, and mother of a West Point graduate, I am passionate about ensuring our service members have what they need to keep our country safe, and our veterans are equipped with the resources they need for a successful transition back to civilian life. **

I am committed to making our American military strong once again to protect our freedoms and way of life. **I want to restore America to the strong country I grew up in so we can leave a better America for our kids and for future generations.**

**_How do we bring America BACK?_**
[**HELP ME BRING BACK THE AMERICAN DREAM!** ](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=8ac200514a9c4ff297be0421393af27c&_e=NmqPQjF7DP0gzDLGHRcqbMCa4gci2it_4IZv9pjKkaem7xXEVvGK7uxlYihQuHGSOWVg7qsNtZcB-2g7sU8iZQ8l72TckldIcicXYp6I59qASBwtG82evSuXkym2tf7EpBdZQMt6yslZuBe-lhix_TJDDakwEa20m9GlCEWCuTl-jCVCzJZkhthnQpXspEfIv3rDUPE4NZgRk9CHcm_idhiRiXM5DJJZ7xpYvDz7V_kMVaZMmEPYK8Bh7a39dlDF7sXL2ghvHcmgp27vat78nsDspJqdhGkmTA66p3028mrkBAkbgerhoY53lOuJXVf9)
---

**This starts with confronting the alarming embrace of a radical, divisive agenda pushed by the Left in our schools, corporations, and institutions.** This "woke" ideology seeks to rewrite American history and undermine the very freedoms our nation was founded upon. I believe that America is the greatest country in the history of the world, and we must teach our children to respect the United States Constitution and the freedoms it affords - the same Constitution I have been upholding every day as a judge.

**I recognize the harm done to Hoosier families by President Biden and the Washington Democrats ' agenda. Our economy is in shambles because of out-of-control liberal spending and inflation.** Biden's negligence has opened our border, and fentanyl is the leading cause of death in working-age Americans as a result.

Rather than just complain and react to these problems as a judge, I am determined to tackle these issues head-on and execute commonsense strategies that will actually help Hoosiers in their daily lives. After fighting fentanyl and illegal immigration in my courtroom for years, I know it is time for me to step out of the judiciary - where I can only react to problems on a case-by-case basis - and proactively take on these nationwide issues I am witnessing in Northeast Indiana.

**In 2015, Governor Pence appointed me to the Governor 's Task Force on Drug Enforcement, Treatment, and Prevention, where I, along with other Indiana state officials and law enforcement, helped to implement statewide solutions to the drug crisis.**

I'm ready to take that experience to Congress and work to improve the lives of Hoosier families across Northeast Indiana. I believe in personal responsibility, small government, and low taxes. I will work to restore our economy and fight against socialist spending policies that hand your hard-earned money over to coastal elites. I will fight against the Left's rejection of truth and ensure that girls' sports are for girls only.

I will be an unabashed voice for the voiceless in Congress and stand for the rights of unborn babies. And I will firmly defend the constitutional rights of all Americans, especially the Second Amendment. [**These are the issues that matter most to me, and you can count on me to deliver.**](http://links.davisforin.com/u/click?_t=3e9e6097e33749f890adf7e8c9b24a4e&_m=8ac200514a9c4ff297be0421393af27c&_e=NmqPQjF7DP0gzDLGHRcqbMCa4gci2it_4IZv9pjKkaem7xXEVvGK7uxlYihQuHGSOWVg7qsNtZcB-2g7sU8iZQ8l72TckldIcicXYp6I59qASBwtG82evSuXkym2tf7Ea2f0VjW1fEJ2m8ZX4Z7as5h4V3n7HoSvoqnSdcWJB2EcnrkLty4SZT_ghz49lwgGMA_2HgMF7EXZ9sSXe5PqvlxpbUuGpj0UVhzgzdKWk7J4nVh1o6eDh2FVTSzdnWQQrCYoVEd37ee7GlSaFCf8MUajQno5_fzEmqVuG2RYXFV3RyLg74gyiJQMectcAYb-)

**_What 's next?_**
Now that you know a bit more about me -- I'd be honored if you could support my run for Congress.

The GOP has one chance to take this country back from the brink of destruction. We have a slim majority in the House, but the U.S. Senate is still in the hands of the radical left.

If we want to enact sweeping changes and restore the conservative values that let my and many other American families prosper -- we need a HUGE red wave in 2024.

It's only with your support that we can make this happen.

**_Is there ANYTHING you can spare to help us SECURE our House Majority and TAKE BACK AMERICA?_**

clean_body: | Hey, I wanted to take a minute and reach out to you to tell my story. As a contender for one of the most important congressional races in the country -- I think it's important everybody knows exactly where I stand leading into this election. So -- let's get right to it. Why am I running for Congress? | Because it's imperative to bring back the strong America we grew up in. For over 12 years, I have served as a Judge for the state of Indiana and was the first female Allen Circuit Court Judge. I took the gravity of my oath seriously, treating every case fairly and refusing to legislate from the bench. I had a duty to enforce the law as written, but my position gave me a unique perspective to see where the law needs to be changed to improve our community and country. I saw firsthand what change is needed in this nation, and I intend to work every day to bring back the America we grew up in. Now, I 'm asking Hoosiers to send me to Congress to restore the American dream. What 's my Story? My two siblings and I were raised in a home centered around Christ and immersed in the value of hard work. My father - the hardest worker I have ever met - came from very humble beginnings and worked his own way through college, eventually earning a Ph.D. My parents raised me to believe in the American dream because our family was living it. Through hard work and dedication, my family prospered. I was instilled with my father's work ethic and determination. A product of Fort Wayne public schools, I went on to attend Wheaton College in Illinois, where I met my future husband, Scott. I continued my education at Valparaiso University School of Law, completing my J.D. at Saint Mary's Law School in San Antonio, Texas when Scott began his active duty in the U.S. Army. As the daughter of a U.S. Army Reservist, the wife of a Lieutenant Colonel in the U.S. Air Force - Indiana Air National Guard, and mother of a West Point graduate, I am passionate about ensuring our service members have what they need to keep our country safe, and our veterans are equipped with the resources they need for a successful transition back to civilian life. I am committed to making our American military strong once again to protect our freedoms and way of life. I want to restore America to the strong country I grew up in so we can leave a better America for our kids and for future generations. How do we bring America BACK? This starts with confronting the alarming embrace of a radical, divisive agenda pushed by the Left in our schools, corporations, and institutions. This "woke" ideology seeks to rewrite American history and undermine the very freedoms our nation was founded upon. I believe that America is the greatest country in the history of the world, and we must teach our children to respect the United States Constitution and the freedoms it affords - the same Constitution I have been upholding every day as a judge. I recognize the harm done to Hoosier families by President Biden and the Washington Democrats ' agenda. Our economy is in shambles because of out-of-control liberal spending and inflation. Biden's negligence has opened our border, and fentanyl is the leading cause of death in working-age Americans as a result. Rather than just complain and react to these problems as a judge, I am determined to tackle these issues head-on and execute commonsense strategies that will actually help Hoosiers in their daily lives. After fighting fentanyl and illegal immigration in my courtroom for years, I know it is time for me to step out of the judiciary - where I can only react to problems on a case-by-case basis - and proactively take on these nationwide issues I am witnessing in Northeast Indiana. In 2015, Governor Pence appointed me to the Governor 's Task Force on Drug Enforcement, Treatment, and Prevention, where I, along with other Indiana state officials and law enforcement, helped to implement statewide solutions to the drug crisis. I'm ready to take that experience to Congress and work to improve the lives of Hoosier families across Northeast Indiana. I believe in personal responsibility, small government, and low taxes. I will work to restore our economy and fight against socialist spending policies that hand your hard-earned money over to coastal elites. I will fight against the Left's rejection of truth and ensure that girls' sports are for girls only. I will be an unabashed voice for the voiceless in Congress and stand for the rights of unborn babies. And I will firmly defend the constitutional rights of all Americans, especially the Second Amendment. - What 's next? Now that you know a bit more about me -- I'd be honored if you could support my run for Congress. The GOP has one chance to take this country back from the brink of destruction. We have a slim majority in the House, but the U.S. Senate is still in the hands of the radical left. If we want to enact sweeping changes and restore the conservative values that let my and many other American families prosper -- we need a HUGE red wave in 2024. It's only with your support that we can make this happen. Is there ANYTHING you can spare to help us SECURE our House Majority and TAKE BACK AMERICA? Thank you, Wendy Davis Paid for by Wendy Davis for Congress

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Can I get wonky for a minute?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
From nursing homes to retail outfits to manufactured-housing communities and beyond, we see a similar pattern.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=104%2E4032634%2EBFVIeN)
---
It’s a story that plays out from industry to industry to industry. From nursing homes to retail outfits to manufactured-housing communities and beyond, we see a similar pattern. Private equity companies or Wall Street investors swoop in. They buy a business. They jack up prices and reduce services, sucking out value in the name of short-term profits. And then they reap the rewards — leaving damage and destruction in their wake as they move along to the next victim. It’s happened to newspapers like the Denver Post. It’s happened to retailers like Toys R Us and ShopKo. And it’s happening all over our housing market. Let’s zoom in on that piece. Last week, I visited Attleboro, Massachusetts, and heard from residents of manufactured-home parks that have been caught up in this pattern. They said rents have increased by hundreds of dollars — some by 75%. Many of the residents are seniors living on fixed incomes. They shouldn’t have to choose between buying groceries, filling prescriptions, or paying rent. But they aren’t alone. Let me get wonky for a minute. Manufactured (or “mobile”) homes have been a critical avenue to affordable housing for millions of Americans. A few decades ago, these communities were generally owned by mom-and-pop businesses. But the private equity industry saw an opportunity. Residents of manufactured home communities often own their own homes but not the land underneath. And since most of these homes aren’t actually mobile, Wall Street vultures realized that families were effectively stuck in place — sitting ducks. They could buy the community, raise rents, save themselves money by refusing to make home repairs, and squeeze every possible penny out of the residents. Nobody should be surprised that these investors are doing this to pad their own profits. Private equity firms get rich by loading companies and real estate they buy with debt, then stripping out all the assets, extracting whatever value they can, and charging exorbitant fees. That is the business model. **And let’s call this what it is: legalized looting.** Looting that makes a handful of Wall Street managers very rich while costing thousands of people their jobs, putting valuable companies out of business, and hurting communities across the country. So while I keep fighting to create more affordable housing in Massachusetts and around the country, I’ll also keep working to protect already-existing housing from corporate investors who just want to wring more profits out of families. And I’ll keep pushing to tackle this economy-wide problem. I have a plan to stop these investors from looting companies and leaving communities high and dry — including by putting private equity firms on the hook for the debts of companies they buy. That way, they’re responsible for the downside of their investments so that they only make money if the companies they control flourish. This is part of how we put our government on the side of working people. **I work for families, not powerful special interests, so I don’t take campaign contributions from private equity executives.** [**And I’m able to stay in this fight because of grassroots supporters like you. If it makes sense for you right now, can you pitch in $28 or any amount to support our re-election campaign and grow our grassroots movement for bold, systemic reform?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/815?amount=28&t=8&akid=104%2E4032634%2EBFVIeN) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

As neighbors, we have an obligation to protect the most vulnerable in our society. **That’s why I'm thrilled that my bill to remediate lead paint in homes and rental units across Delaware was signed into law.** Why lead paint? Lead-based paint is one of the most serious threats to the health and welfare of children here in Delaware. It’s so pervasive, so ordinary, and so many have largely forgotten that it exists at all. ✖️Though the federal government banned lead paint in 1978, nearly 30% of _all homes in the United States_ still contain lead-based paint. ✖️Nearly 60% of Delaware’s housing was constructed before lead-based paint was banned 45 years ago. ✖️Every year, roughly 500 small children here in Delaware test positive for elevated levels of lead in their blood, most of whom live in rental properties in high-poverty areas. **Protecting kids from lead paint is critical.** Exposure to lead paint slows children’s growth and contributes significantly to problems with hearing and speech and damage to the brain and nervous system. My legislation — SB 9 — creates a process by which the state funds home lead paint remediation projects, and provides temporary housing for those who need LBP removed from their homes. It was an honor to work side by side with Action for Delaware’s Children and Lead-Free Delaware — two organizations that show the power of people to bring about real progress.
